cases.prompt:
An ultra-realistic cinematic dreamy lifestyle photo of a young woman sitting alone on top of a vintage turquoise van in a vast flower field, captured from a closer low-angle perspective.
Tighter framing focusing on her upper body and the rooftop section of the van, creating an intimate, peaceful, youthful composition.
The young woman sits casually on the edge of the van roof, wearing a light pastel summer dress and white sneakers, legs hanging naturally off the side, holding a small bouquet of wildflowers in one hand.
She looks slightly upward toward the sky with a soft natural smile, relaxed expression, carefree and warm energy.
Her hair is gently blown by the wind, loose strands moving naturally, dress fabric flowing softly.
A cluster of pastel blue balloons is tied beside her, floating lightly and adding whimsical softness.
Cute doodles integrated around the scene: hand-drawn flowers, smiley faces, stars, hearts, sparkles, tiny butterflies, little clouds.
Handwritten-style white sketch text floating in the sky like a diary page, playful phrases such as “my happy place”, “bloom”, “sunny day”, mixed with doodles.
Wide soft blue sky dominates the background with large negative space, airy and clean composition.
Bright natural daylight, soft overexposed highlights, dreamy glow, soft bloom effect, pastel film tones, low contrast, smooth highlight roll-off.
Color palette: turquoise, sky blue, soft white, pastel pink, pastel yellow, warm cream.
Style: cinematic editorial lifestyle photography, Korean indie aesthetic, nostalgic youth diary vibe, Kodak Portra 160 film look, soft grain, ultra-detailed, dreamy realism, 8K, aspect ratio 3:4.

cases.title: 超写实3D角色拆解时尚海报
cases.imageAlt: 超写实3D角色拆解时尚海报
cases.prompt:
基于用户提供的参考图片，创作一张超高品质、照片级写实的3D角色拆解艺术海报。将人物转换为Unreal Engine 5 (Metahuman) 级别的超写实数字人，并将其极具个人魅力的私人物品以严谨的"Knolling"风格进行布局展示。

画面比例：16:9 横版
艺术风格核心：时尚超写实主义 (Fashion Hyper-realism) — 极致的皮肤质感、奢华的材质表现、诱惑的电影氛围。
质量标杆：对标 Tom Ford/Gucci 的时尚广告大片、赛博朋克2077的高端角色建模、Vogue 摄影作品。

📷 物品布局 (Item Layout) - Knolling 放射式构图
总物品数：25-30件，围绕角色呈放射状排列，注重留白与呼吸感。

分类1：高定穿搭 (Haute Couture) - 深红丝绒标签
- 主服装拆解：
  - 如果是女性：黑色丝绸吊带裙（展现丝滑垂坠感）、极细高跟鞋（红底）、蕾丝内衬细节、透明黑丝袜（展现透肤度和光泽）。
  - 如果是男性：解开领口的丝质衬衫、定制西装马甲、手工皮鞋（镜面光泽）。
- 材质重点：重点表现丝绸的流光、皮革的纹理、肌肤与布料接触的压痕。

分类2：私密美妆 (Intimate Beauty) - 香槟金标签
- 妆容细节：口红（膏体带水润光泽，管身留有指纹）、眼影盘（碎钻闪粉质感）、昂贵的复古香水瓶（琥珀色液体）。
- 氛围道具：一支燃烧了一半的香薰蜡烛（带烟雾）、一杯红酒（挂杯细节清晰）。
*示例：口红盖子打开，旁边有一张印着吻痕的餐巾纸。*

分类3：奢华配饰 (Luxury Accessories) - 铂金标签
- 珠宝：钻石项链（强烈的色散火彩）、蛇形手镯、机械腕表（透视机芯）。
- 随身物：真皮手包（细腻的荔枝纹）、金属烟盒或雪茄剪、豪华跑车钥匙。

分类4：欲望符号 (Symbols of Desire) - 霓虹紫标签
- 道具：一副复古墨镜、胶片相机、一本未读完的时尚杂志、黑胶唱片。
- 暗示性物品：散落的珍珠、一朵红玫瑰（花瓣带露珠）。

📷 角色呈现 (Character Presentation)
- 姿态：不再是标准的站立，而是略带慵懒、自信的姿势（如坐在隐形的高脚椅上，眼神直视镜头，带有强烈的吸引力）。
- 皮肤细节：必须展现真实的毛孔、细微的汗毛、嘴唇的纹理、锁骨的阴影。皮肤要有“微出汗”的光泽感(Dewy Skin)。

📷 爆炸视图技术 (Exploded View Technique)
- 连接线：极细的金色激光线，带有极简的科技感。
- 引导设计：不再使用普通箭头，而是使用光晕引导视线。
- 技术注释：字体极小且锐利，类似于高端医学美容或时尚杂志的分析图。

📷 视觉包装 · THE AESTHETICS OF ALLURE 📷
- 字体：Didot 或 Bodoni（经典的时尚衬线体），极细字重，白色或金色。
- 副标题 (手写体)："Elegance is an attitude / 优雅即是态度"
- 色彩方案：
  - 深邃暗调：午夜蓝(#000033) + 勃艮第红(#800020) + 香槟金(#D4AF37)。
  - 赛博魅惑：黑色背景 + 霓虹紫(#B026FF) + 电光蓝(#00FFFF)。

📷 背景与氛围 (Background & Atmosphere)
- 光影设计 (Lighting)：
  - **伦勃朗光 (Rembrandt Lighting)**：在面部形成戏剧性的三角光区。
  - **轮廓光 (Rim Light)**：强烈的背光勾勒出角色的身体曲线和发丝边缘。
- 背景：深色背景，带有焦散光斑(Caustics)或模糊的城市夜景灯光(City Bokeh)。
- 特效：轻微的烟雾缭绕，增加神秘感和空气感。

📷 技术规格 (Technical Specifications)
- 渲染引擎：Octane Render 或 Unreal Engine 5。
- 物理材质 (PBR)：
  - **皮肤**：真实的人类皮肤着色器，包含次表面散射(SSS)和微量油脂层。
  - **布料**：丝绸必须有各向异性(Anisotropic)反光；丝袜要有半透明Alpha通道处理。
  - **金属**：高反射，带指纹污渍的真实感。
- 摄影机：85mm 人像焦段，大光圈 (f/1.8) 虚化背景，焦点锐利地锁定在角色眼睛和关键物品上。

📷 后期处理 (Post-Processing)
- 色调：电影感调色 (Teal & Orange 或 Black & Gold)。
- 辉光：高光处添加明显的柔光滤镜效果 (Pro-Mist Filter look)，让皮肤看起来更梦幻。
- 锐化：强化眼部和珠宝的锐度。

📷 质量基准：
画面必须摆脱“塑料感”和“模型感”，达到甚至超越 8K 摄影照片的质感。角色必须具有灵魂和性张力，眼神能穿透屏幕。

cases.title: 汉唐宫廷舞16宫格分镜图
cases.imageAlt: 汉唐宫廷舞16宫格分镜图
cases.prompt:
请创作一张高完成度、高清晰度的「汉唐宫廷舞 / 霓裳羽衣舞 · 16宫格分镜图」。

【整体定位】
这不是普通古风写真，也不是单纯舞蹈教学图，而是一张融合「汉唐宫廷舞」「霓裳羽衣舞」「真实宫苑空间」「电影分镜感」「16步动作编排」的高完成度分镜海报。
整体要像一段盛唐宫廷舞的完整编舞被拆解成16个关键画面，每一格既清晰独立，又有连续流动感，方便后续用于视频生成。

【场景设定】
不要舞台，不要空黑背景，不要现代摄影棚。
场景必须是一个真实、立体、优美、符合汉唐时代气质的盛唐宫苑空间：
- 傍晚金蓝时刻，宫灯初上
- 朱红宫柱
- 金色宫灯
- 宫廷回廊 / 大殿外庭院
- 石阶、栏杆、轻纱帷幔
- 远处可见层叠殿宇与宫苑深景
- 空间有明确前景、中景、后景，具有真实纵深感
- 整体氛围华美、通透、盛世感强，不要乌漆麻黑，不要浑浊，不要色斑

【人物设定】
主角是一位年轻中国女舞者，带有盛唐宫廷舞者气质，端庄、华美、优雅、克制。
她在16格中必须保持同一张脸、同一人物身份、同一气质、同一套服装体系，不要每格都像换了一个人。

【服装与妆造】
服装为汉唐宫廷舞服 / 霓裳羽衣风格：
- 高腰长裙
- 大袖
- 轻纱披帛
- 精致发髻
- 金色发饰、步摇
- 少量花钿或唐风妆感
- 裙摆、披帛、大袖都要有真实动态
推荐配色：
- 胭脂粉
- 象牙白
- 香槟金
- 淡石青
整体华丽但不俗艳。

【版式要求】
- 画面采用 4×4 的16宫格分镜排版
- 每格都有明显编号 1-16
- 每格都有中文动作标题
- 每格可有简洁中文说明或短句提示
- 每格都要像一个独立镜头画面
- 适当加入动作方向箭头或轨迹线，增强分镜感
- 整体清晰、工整、信息完整，但不要过度拥挤
- 分辨率要非常高清，线条清楚，人物和背景都清晰，不要糊，不要脏，不要有色斑

【动作分镜顺序】
1. 宫苑亮相  
舞者站在宫苑中央，微侧身，长裙曳地，一手轻提大袖，一手自然垂落，建立盛唐气场。
2. 起袖迎风  
双臂缓缓抬起，大袖与披帛轻轻被带起，像乐声初起。
3. 拈花侧行  
舞者缓步前行，一手做拈花或兰花指，一手大袖舒展在身后，动作优雅。
4. 开袖成云  
双袖向两侧大幅展开，形成对称而华丽的大开构图，像云气铺开。
5. 回眸转廊  
舞者经过宫柱或回廊边缘，身体转向侧背，再缓缓回眸。
6. 环步绕帛  
脚下走环步，披帛绕身形成流动轨迹，双臂一前一后，动作圆润。
7. 旋裙开宴  
原地或小范围旋转，长裙与披帛打开，形成华丽旋舞。
8. 折腰扬袖  
身体轻折，一袖高扬，一袖下垂，形成斜向张力构图。
9. 低身献礼  
半蹲或单膝低位，双手托袖向前，动作像宫廷献礼，具有礼乐仪式感。
10. 仰身拂云  
从低位起身，上半身轻微后仰，双袖向上扬起，披帛向后飞，动作华美但真人可完成。
11. 飞步掠庭  
向侧前方做一个轻盈掠步，大袖和披帛向后带出，形成位移动线。
12. 盛唐大旋  
最华丽的一次大旋转，长裙、披帛、大袖同时打开，是整套最强高潮之一。
13. 回身收袖  
从大旋中自然回身，双袖由外向内慢慢收回，动作从大开转向收束。
14. 托月举袖  
一手高举如托月，一手横于胸前，身体向上拉长，披帛在身侧形成弧线，仪式感强。
15. 合袖礼成  
双袖缓缓合拢至胸前，形成“礼成”动作，神情宁静庄重。
16. 霓裳定格  
最终大定格，一袖高扬，一袖低垂，身体优雅扭转，长裙铺开，端庄华美地完成收尾。

【重点要求】
- 必须突出真实空间感与时代感
- 必须保持同一舞者一致性
- 必须有完整的大袖、披帛、长裙动态
- 必须适合后续作为视频分镜参考
- 每一格动作都要明显不同，不能过于重复
- 画面整体要华丽、优美、清晰、通透
- 不要黑压压，不要脏，不要模糊，不要色斑，不要廉价古风感

cases.title: 五一旅行美食海报生成
cases.imageAlt: 五一旅行美食海报生成
cases.prompt:
你是一个旅行美食推荐系统 + 高食欲感海报生成系统。

你的任务是：
根据用户输入的「旅游城市名称」或「具体旅游景点名称」，
自动生成一张 9:16 竖版「五一旅行美食推荐海报」。

用户输入：
{城市名称 / 景点名称}

一、地点识别逻辑

如果用户输入的是城市：
直接围绕该城市推荐当地代表性美食。

如果用户输入的是景点：
先自动判断该景点所在城市或区域，
再推荐该景点周边或该城市最值得游客尝试的本地美食。

二、内容生成要求

至少推荐 6 种美食。
每种美食必须包含：

1. 美食名称
2. 一句话推荐理由
3. 一个实用小 Tip
4. 一张高食欲感美食照片

推荐的 6 种美食应覆盖不同类型：

1. 本地招牌菜
2. 经典小吃
3. 早餐 / 早茶 / 主食
4. 甜品 / 饮品
5. 夜宵 / 烟火气美食
6. 本地隐藏体验型美食

三、Tip 要求

每个 Tip 必须短小、实用、有旅行价值。
避免空泛表达。

例如：
白切鸡：蘸姜葱蓉更香
肠粉：趁热吃口感最好
烧鹅：优先选皮脆肉嫩款
双皮奶：冷吃更清爽
牛杂：可加萝卜更入味
云吞面：先喝汤更地道

四、视觉风格

生成一张明亮、干净、色彩丰富、让人有食欲的美食推荐海报。

整体风格：
现代旅行信息卡片海报
高食欲感美食摄影
小红书 / 朋友圈 / 公众号封面风
明亮、通透、整齐、好收藏

背景：
暖白色、奶油色或浅米色背景
轻微纸张纹理或柔和渐变
不要暗黑背景
不要杂乱餐厅环境

五、版式结构

画面比例：9:16 竖版

顶部：
大标题：
五一去「{城市 / 景点}」吃什么？

副标题：
6 款本地美食推荐，一张图收藏

右上角小标签：
May Day Food Guide

中部：
使用 2 列 × 3 行美食卡片布局。
每张卡片有轻微圆角、柔和阴影、清晰边距。
每张卡片上半部分是美食照片，下半部分是文字信息。

每张卡片文字结构：
美食名称
一句话推荐理由
Tip：实用小建议

底部：
添加一句收藏引导文案：
第一次来这里，按这张图吃不容易踩雷。

六、美食照片要求

每张美食照片必须真实、有食欲、色彩丰富。
使用高质量商业美食摄影风格：

45 度近景拍摄
自然柔光
食物纹理清晰
酱汁、油光、蒸汽、焦香感明显
色彩鲜艳但真实
构图干净
突出主食物
背景不过度抢眼

避免：
食物变形
错误食材
文字乱码
过度油腻
画面昏暗
低清晰度
塑料质感
菜单式排版
信息拥挤

七、整体效果

这张海报要让用户一眼知道：
去这个城市应该吃什么。

同时具备：
食欲感
收藏价值
旅行实用性
整齐排版
社交传播感

cases.title: 设计高端汽水海报
cases.imageAlt: 设计高端汽水海报
cases.prompt:
请创作一张高完成度的「风味汽水沉浸主视觉海报 / Flavor Immersion Soda Hero Poster」。

【用户输入】
风味主题：【风味主题】
包装类型：【包装类型，如 slim can / standard can / glass bottle / retro glass soda bottle；如未填写则默认 slim can】
品牌名：【品牌名；如未填写则自动生成】
产品名：【产品名；如未填写则根据主题自动生成】
主色调：【主色调；如未填写则根据风味主题自动匹配】
画幅比例：【画幅比例，如 4:5、3:4、1:1；如未填写则默认竖版 4:5】

请根据以上信息，生成一张品牌级、高完成度、高冲击力的汽水主视觉海报。整张图必须明确表现为“汽水 / sparkling soda / carbonated soft drink”的商业广告视觉，而不是果汁、奶茶、smoothie、厚重果饮或普通静物摆拍。

【整体定位】
这不是普通产品摆拍，也不是传统平面海报，而是一张以风味汽水为核心主角、以对应风味元素构建沉浸式环境的高端品牌主视觉图。整体应具有强烈的商业摄影感、品牌广告感、冰镇清爽感和视觉冲击力，适合用于新品推广、品牌海报、电商首图、社交媒体封面和广告KV。

【中央主角】
画面中央必须出现一款非常突出的【包装类型】风味汽水产品。该产品应沿画面中轴线摆放，成为绝对视觉核心，完整、清晰、精致、有体积感、质感真实。包装设计要高级、简洁、像真实存在的商业汽水品牌。包装上需体现【品牌名】与【产品名】，文字不宜过多，但要具备清楚的品牌识别度。产品必须比背景和周围风味元素更清晰、更突出、更有存在感。

【风味沉浸环境】
围绕中央汽水产品，构建一个与【风味主题】高度相关的沉浸式风味环境。若是水果口味，则使用相应水果；若是茶感、花香、草本、香料、复合口味等主题，则使用与该风味有关的真实元素、原料或意象。它们应大量铺陈并包围中央产品，形成高密度的前景、中景、背景层次，营造强烈的风味氛围与视觉包裹感。元素之间要自然衔接，丰富但不杂乱，辅助氛围必须服务于汽水主体，而不能喧宾夺主。

【汽水属性强化】
必须明显强化“汽水”的视觉识别，而非普通饮料。请重点表现：
- 冰镇冷饮感
- 细腻丰富的冷凝水珠
- 微小的碳酸气泡 / fizz
- 清爽、通透、轻微爆发感
- 刚从冰箱拿出的新鲜冰爽状态

产品表面必须有高质量、细节丰富的水珠，质感逼真；必要时可加入轻微冷雾感、气泡感、飞溅感，但整体要克制，不要过度夸张。

【摄影与构图】
采用【画幅比例】构图，优先保持竖版品牌广告的主视觉逻辑。整体构图为居中英雄式构图，中央产品最清晰，风味元素在四周构建空间层次。可以有少量前景虚化元素增强纵深感，中景围绕产品形成清晰包裹，背景浓郁饱满并自然过渡。使用高端商业摄影语言：浅景深、微距细节、真实镜头虚化、通透高光、细腻反射、专业棚拍光影。画面应拥有极强的视觉吸引力。

【色彩策略】
整体色彩围绕【主色调】展开，如未指定则根据【风味主题】自动匹配。色彩需要统一、鲜明、有记忆点，并能快速传达该汽水的风味印象。可以适当使用深色阴影、局部高光与少量点缀色增强层次，但不能显得杂乱。整体颜色应浓郁、诱人、高级、有品牌质感。

【风格方向】
整体风格应为：
premium, refreshing, immersive, bold, high-end commercial photography, soda brand key visual。
它要比普通产品图更强、更美、更完整，既有很强的视觉冲击力，又保持品牌级的精致和高级感。

【适用感】
最终效果应像一张真正的官方汽水品牌主视觉海报，可直接用于品牌传播、产品推广、社媒封面、电商主图和广告展示。

【避免】
不要生成普通果汁广告感；
不要弱化中央汽水主体；
不要让水果或原料比产品更抢戏；
不要做成插画风、廉价海报风或低质拼贴感；
不要有过多文案、杂乱图标和复杂说明；
不要让包装严重变形或文字过于混乱；
不要缺少冷凝水珠、冰镇感和汽水的碳酸气泡氛围。

cases.imageAlt: 高级商务证件照头像海报设计
cases.prompt:
英文提示词:
Please generate a formal business profile headshot poster based on the portrait photo I uploaded. Retain the character's true identity features, facial proportions, basic face shape, and overall temperament, do not change the character's identity.

You can moderately optimize the facial contours to make the facial lines clearer, more natural, and more photogenic; smooth the skin texture, reduce blemishes, dullness, and uneven skin tone, but do not over-smooth, retain real skin details and natural light and shadow.

Please design a matching business hairstyle according to the character's face shape. The hairstyle should be clean, neat, mature, professional, suitable for formal occasions, with natural and layered hair strands, not exaggerated. Please pair the character with formal business attire, such as a dark suit jacket, a white or light-colored shirt, optionally paired with a tie. The overall styling should be high-end, concise, professional, and trustworthy.

The image is a front-facing half-body portrait, the character is centered, looking straight at the camera, with a natural and confident expression. Top-right: The boy uses a Supreme money gun, shooting fake money toward the camera in a dynamic pose. The girl reacts dramatically -laughing and shielding herself playfully.
Energetic and chaotic frame.
Bottom-left: The girl pulls the boy's cheek
playfully while he overreacts. Both wear cute plush/animal hats, creating a funny, chaotic couple moment.
Bottom-right: Both pose close together with
mock-serious expressions, holding fake mustache props under their noses like they're pretending to be classy adults. Slight attitude but still playful.
Expressions: goofy, expressive, teasing, sweet, slightly awkward in a charming way-authentic photobox couple vibe.
Composition: tight photobooth framing, consistent camera angle, slight variation per frame, evenly spaced grid with thin white borders, vertical photostrip layout. Style: ultra-realistic photography, Korean photobooth aesthetic, high resolution, no cartoon or illustration."

Prompt 2:
"Highly realistic 1:1 photobooth-style 4-grid (2×2) layout with thin borders, soft spacing, slightly rounded corners. Authentic booth feel: tight framing, slight lens distortion, direct flash, subtle print texture, minor imperfections (blur, uneven exposure, slight misalignment). Frames (L→R, top→bottom):
Top-left: extreme close-up distortion; girl points camera at lens, boy leans in below with exaggerated expression.
Top-right: boy crouching with money gun, looking up; girl standing above in sunglasses, confident, off-center.
Bottom-left: girl playfully swings/points bat sideways; boy leans back dodging, motion blur.
Bottom-right: seated close; girl adjusts sunglasses facing camera, boy looks at her holding camera on lap.
Style: ultra-realistic photobooth aesthetic, candid interaction, expressive compositions, natural flash, visible skin texture, balanced chaos with control.

柔和的影棚灯光，自然的皮肤纹理，逼真的阴影，高细节，抓拍的大头贴感觉。
每一帧都有独特、俏皮、非基础的情侣姿势，最多使用1-2个道具：左上：两人都向镜头倾斜，带有夸张的震惊表情（睁大眼睛，张开嘴巴）。女孩抓住男孩的手臂，而他戏剧性地摆出框脸的姿势。他们戴着美观的透明眼镜。

充满活力和混乱的画面。

而他反应过度。两人都戴着可爱的毛绒/动物帽子，创造了一个有趣、混乱的情侣时刻。
右下：两人紧挨着摆姿势，带着
假装严肃的表情，鼻子下面拿着假胡子道具，假装他们是优雅的成年人。带点态度但仍然俏皮。
表情：傻气、丰富、戏弄、甜蜜、带点迷人的笨拙——真实的大头贴情侣氛围。
构图：紧凑的大头贴取景，一致的相机角度，每帧略有变化，带有细白边框的均匀间距网格，垂直照片条布局。风格：超写实摄影，韩式大头贴美学，高分辨率，没有卡通或插画。

道具：墨镜，小相机，风格化的棒球棒，玩具钱枪（在各个画面中使用，不是一次性全部使用）。
画面（从左到右，从上到下）：
左上：极端的特写畸变；女孩将相机对准镜头，男孩在下方探出脸，表情夸张。

风格：超写实的大头贴美学，抓拍互动，富有表现力的构图，自然闪光，可见的皮肤纹理，平衡的混乱与控制。

The hands of the watch become sleek bridges connecting structures. Tiny figures move through the city as if living inside time itself. A warm sunrise crosses the dial from one side while night still exists on the other side, showing multiple times of day within one world. The watch is both an object and an ecosystem. It should feel like time is something constructed, inhabited, and mastered.

Composition:
The watch fills a large portion of the poster, angled slightly toward camera. The city-inside-the-dial concept must be ultra-detailed and luxurious. The background should be deep and elegant with subtle gold lighting and soft shadow gradients.

Color palette:
Gold, dark green, black, steel silver, warm ivory light.

Main headline:
"TIME, BUILT TO LAST"
Product title:
"Rolex"
Subheadline:
"Where precision becomes legacy."
Feature callouts:
- "Swiss Precision"
- "Iconic Craftsmanship"
- "Timeless Design"
- "A World Within Every Second"
CTA:
"Wear what endures"
Footer copy:
"Not just measured. Mastered."

Style:
Hyper-realistic luxury watch campaign, miniature world concept, ultra-premium lighting, macro detail, elegant editorial typography, museum-level sophistication.

超写实奢华腕表广告，微缩世界概念，超高端灯光，微距细节，优雅的编辑排版字体，博物馆级别的精致感。

cases.title: AI体态比例优化报告
cases.imageAlt: AI体态比例优化报告
cases.prompt:
英文提示词:
Please generate a horizontal 4:3 high-completion "AI Posture & Body Proportion Analysis Report" based on the full-body front and full-body side real-person photos I uploaded.

This report is not a medical diagnosis, not a before-and-after weight loss comparison, nor an exaggerated weight loss effect image, but a "Visual Posture Analysis + Proportion Management + Outfit Optimization + Posture Calibration Simulation" report based on real-person photos. Please strictly retain the user's own facial recognition, facial features structure, sense of age, real skin texture, hairstyle and temperament, body foundation and original identity. Do not swap faces, do not turn the person into someone else, do not create exaggerated weight loss or unrealistic body changes.

[Core Settings]
Before: Show the user's current natural standing posture state, including front and side two perspectives, retaining the real body shape, real clothing, and natural posture.
After: Show the simulated state of the same person after "Posture Calibration + Outfit Optimization + Visual Proportion Adjustment". The focus is on being more upright, more relaxed, more energetic, and showing more coordinated proportions, rather than becoming thinner, bonier, or drastically changing the body shape.
Please understand After as "a better visual state presented on the same day through correct standing posture, core tightening, shoulder and neck relaxation, pelvic repositioning, and outfit line optimization".

[Highest Priority Principles]
1. Do not make medical diagnoses, only perform visual posture and outfit proportion analysis.
2. Do not use humiliating words, do not judge whether the appearance is good or bad, do not create body anxiety.
3. Do not exaggerate body shape changes, do not forcefully slim down, do not change fat distribution, do not change bone structure.
4. All data should be presented in the form of "AI Visual Estimate / Visual Estimate", do not pretend to be real medical measurements.
5. The language should be gentle, professional, data-driven, and encouraging, focusing on expressing "optimizable space", "more coordinated proportions", "more relaxed posture", and "more compatible outfit".

[Overall Layout]
Horizontal 4:3, high-end health management consultant report + fashion magazine infographic style. The background uses clean off-white, light gray, or low-saturation warm white, paired with thin line frames, numbered labels, partial enlargement boxes, posture baseline, vertical center of gravity line, curve annotations, and concise charts. The overall information volume is rich but not crowded, professional, with a sense of design, suitable for sharing on Xiaohongshu or X.

[Title Area]
Main Title: AI Posture & Body Proportion Analysis Report
English Subtitle: Posture & Body Proportion Analysis Report
Sub Title: Before Natural Posture → After Posture & Styling Reset
Corner Mark: Non-medical diagnosis · AI Visual Estimate · Posture & outfit optimization simulation

[Main Visual Area]
Adopt a four-image comparison structure:
The left side is BEFORE:
- Before Front Image: Retain the user's natural standing posture, natural outfit, and real body shape
- Before Side Image: Show the natural side posture

The right side is AFTER:
- After Front Image: Same person, same identity, similar angle, posture is more upright, shoulders and neck are more relaxed, waist and abdomen lines are more optimized by the outfit, overall proportions are more coordinated
- After Side Image: Same person, showing from the side that the head and neck position is more retracted, shoulders and back are more open, pelvis position is more neutral, forward bulging sensation of the abdomen is reduced, knees are not overly locked, overall center of gravity is more stable

The four character images must be clear, similar in size, and have a clear comparison relationship. Do not let After become a completely different person, and do not over-beautify or over-slim.

[Posture Analysis Annotation Area]
Please use thin line arrows, numbers, and partial enlargement boxes to annotate the following parts on the Before and After images:

1. Head & Neck Position / Head & Neck Alignment
Before can be annotated: Forward head, obvious neck pressure sensation
After can be annotated: Chin slightly tucked, neck lines more relaxed

2. Shoulder & Upper Arm Position / Shoulder & Upper Arm Position
Before can be annotated: Rounded shoulder trend, scapulae protracted, upper arm position forward
After can be annotated: Shoulder lines opened, upper body more upright

3. Ribcage & Upper Back / Ribcage & Upper Back
Before can be annotated: Ribcage forward bulging, insufficient back support
After can be annotated: Ribcage more stable, back curves more natural

4. Waist & Abdomen Position / Waist & Abdomen
Before can be annotated: Abdomen visually forward bulging, waistline unclear
After can be annotated: Weaken the forward bulging sensation through posture and outfit, waistline clearer

5. Pelvis & Hip Position / Pelvis & Hip Position
Before can be annotated: Anterior pelvic tilt trend, hip center of gravity not stable enough
After can be annotated: Pelvis closer to neutral position, hip support more stable

6. Thigh & Knee Position / Thigh & Knee Alignment
Before can be annotated: Inner thigh pressure sensation, knee locked or hyperextended trend
After can be annotated: Leg force distribution more balanced, knee state more natural

7. Vertical Center of Gravity Line / Vertical Balance Line
Before can be annotated: Head, shoulders, pelvis, knees, ankles are not completely on the same visual center of gravity line
After can be annotated: Center of gravity line more stable, overall more upright

[Data Comparison Column]
Please use clear charts to show the AI Visual Estimate indicators of Before → After. All indicators must be marked with "Visual Estimate", do not write them as real medical tests. Suggested data are as follows:

- Neck Alignment / Neck Alignment: 6.1 → 8.4
- Shoulder Openness / Shoulder Openness: 5.8 → 8.2
- Pelvic Stability / Pelvic Stability: 5.9 → 8.0
- Waist-Abdomen Balance / Waist-Abdomen Balance: 6.0 → 8.1
- Vertical Balance / Vertical Balance: 6.3 → 8.6
- Styling Compatibility / Styling Compatibility: 6.5 → 9.0
- Posture Presence / Posture Presence: 6.2 → 8.8

Please use progress bars, radar charts, or comparison number cards to present, visually clear but not exaggerated.

[Curve & Proportion Analysis Area]
Please draw lightweight line graphs or body outline curve schematics to show:
- Neck and shoulder lines
- Back curves
- Waist and abdomen lines
- Pelvic angle trends
- Leg vertical lines
- Front left-right balance sense

The lines should look like professional posture assessment diagrams, not medical diagnosis diagrams, and must not create a sense of intimidation.

[Outfit Optimization Suggestion Area]
Please show 3 daily outfit plans suitable for the After state. Each set includes a small thumbnail, style keywords, and one sentence of reason:

Look 01: Commuting shows steadiness
Keywords: Straight silhouette, deep and light layering, coat modifies shoulders and back
Reason: Through the coat shoulder line and straight-leg bottoms, weaken the forward bulging sensation of the abdomen, and enhance the vertical proportion.

Look 02: Weekend light sports
Keywords: Functional fabrics, slightly loose, short top and long bottom
Reason: Improve comfort while making body lines more relaxed and extended.

Look 03: Urban light trendy
Keywords: Short coat, high waistline, neat shoe type
Reason: Elevate the visual center of gravity, making the overall look more upright, younger, and more energetic.

[Action Suggestion Area]
Please add a small module "7-Day Posture Reset / 7-Day Posture Reset", with gentle and executable content:
- 3 minutes of chin tuck exercise every day
- 5 minutes of thoracic spine opening every day
- 5 minutes of hip flexor stretching every day
- 10 glute bridge activations every day
- Avoid locking knees when standing
- Keep feet stable, ribs tucked, and shoulders and neck relaxed when taking photos

Please note that these suggestions can only serve as daily posture management suggestions, do not write them as treatment plans.

[Bottom Summary]
Please summarize with a gentle and powerful sentence:
"This is not about getting thin overnight, but through posture calibration, center of gravity adjustment, and outfit line management, making the same body present a more relaxed, more upright, and more confident state."

[Strictly Avoid]
Do not show nudity or underwear; do not make it revealing; do not shame the body; do not use negative words like "obesity defects", "fat problems", "very bad figure"; do not exaggerate weight loss; do not pretend to make medical diagnoses; do not fabricate real body fat percentage, real waist circumference, real weight; do not turn the user into someone else; do not over-beautify; do not let After become an unrealistic influencer figure.

中文提示词:
请基于我上传的全身正面与全身侧面真人照片，生成一张横向 4:3 的高完成度「AI 体态比例管理报告 / AI Posture & Body Proportion Analysis Report」。

本报告不是医学诊断，不是减肥前后对比，也不是夸张瘦身效果图，而是一张基于真人照片进行的「视觉体态分析 + 比例管理 + 穿搭优化 + 姿态校准模拟」报告。请严格保留用户本人的脸部辨识度、五官结构、年龄感、皮肤真实质感、发型气质、身材基础和原始身份，不要换脸，不要把人变成另一个人，不要制造夸张减重或不现实的身材变化。

【核心设定】
Before：展示用户当前自然站姿状态，包含正面与侧面两个视角，保留真实体型、真实穿着和自然姿态。
After：展示同一人在「姿态校准 + 穿搭优化 + 视觉比例调整」后的模拟状态，重点是更挺拔、更舒展、更有精神、更显比例协调，而不是变瘦、变骨感或大幅改变身材。
请把 After 理解为「同一天通过正确站姿、核心收紧、肩颈放松、骨盆回正、穿搭线条优化后呈现出的更佳视觉状态」。

【最高优先级原则】
1. 不做医学诊断，只做视觉体态与穿搭比例分析。
2. 不使用羞辱性词汇，不评价外貌好坏，不制造身材焦虑。
3. 不夸张改变体型，不强行瘦身，不改变脂肪分布，不改变骨骼结构。
4. 所有数据均以「AI视觉估算 / Visual Estimate」形式呈现，不冒充真实医学测量。
5. 语言温和、专业、数据化、鼓励性，重点表达“可优化空间”“比例更协调”“体态更舒展”“穿搭更适配”。

【整体版式】
横向 4:3，高端健康管理顾问报告 + 时尚杂志信息图风格。背景使用干净米白、浅灰或低饱和暖白色，配合细线框、编号标签、局部放大框、姿态基准线、垂直重心线、曲线标注和简洁图表。整体信息量丰富但不拥挤，专业、有设计感、适合小红书或 X 分享。

【标题区】
主标题：AI 体态比例管理报告
英文副标题：Posture & Body Proportion Analysis Report
小标题：Before Natural Posture → After Posture & Styling Reset
角标：非医学诊断 · AI视觉估算 · 姿态与穿搭优化模拟

【主视觉区】
采用四图对比结构：
左侧为 BEFORE：
- Before 正面图：保留用户自然站姿、自然穿搭、真实体型
- Before 侧面图：展示自然侧面体态

右侧为 AFTER：
- After 正面图：同一人、同一身份、相似角度，姿态更挺拔，肩颈更舒展，腰腹线条更被穿搭优化，整体比例更协调
- After 侧面图：同一人，侧面展示头颈位置更回正、肩背更打开、骨盆位置更中立、腹部前顶感降低、膝盖不过度锁死，整体重心更稳定

四张人物图必须清晰、大小接近、对比关系明确。不要让 After 变成完全不同的人，也不要过度美颜或过度瘦身。

【体态分析标注区】
请在 Before 与 After 图上使用细线箭头、编号和局部放大框标注以下部位：

1. 头颈位置 / Head & Neck Alignment
Before 可标注：头部前伸、颈部压力感更明显
After 可标注：下巴微收、颈部线条更舒展

2. 肩部与上臂 / Shoulder & Upper Arm Position
Before 可标注：圆肩趋势、肩胛前引、上臂位置偏前
After 可标注：肩线打开、上半身更挺拔

3. 胸廓与背部 / Ribcage & Upper Back
Before 可标注：胸廓前顶、背部支撑不足
After 可标注：胸廓更稳定，背部曲线更自然

4. 腰腹位置 / Waist & Abdomen
Before 可标注：腹部视觉前顶，腰线不清晰
After 可标注：通过站姿与穿搭弱化前顶感，腰线更清楚

5. 骨盆与髋部 / Pelvis & Hip Position
Before 可标注：骨盆前倾趋势，髋部重心不够稳定
After 可标注：骨盆更接近中立位，髋部支撑更稳定

6. 大腿与膝盖 / Thigh & Knee Alignment
Before 可标注：大腿内侧压力感、膝盖锁死或超伸趋势
After 可标注：腿部受力更均衡，膝盖状态更自然

7. 垂直重心线 / Vertical Balance Line
Before 可标注：头、肩、骨盆、膝盖、脚踝不完全在同一视觉重心线上
After 可标注：重心线更稳定，整体更挺拔

【数据对比栏】
请用清晰图表展示 Before → After 的 AI视觉估算指标。所有指标都要标注「Visual Estimate」，不要写成真实医学检测。建议数据如下：

- 头颈对齐度 / Neck Alignment：6.1 → 8.4
- 肩背打开度 / Shoulder Openness：5.8 → 8.2
- 骨盆稳定感 / Pelvic Stability：5.9 → 8.0
- 腰腹视觉平衡 / Waist-Abdomen Balance：6.0 → 8.1
- 垂直重心稳定 / Vertical Balance：6.3 → 8.6
- 穿搭修饰效率 / Styling Compatibility：6.5 → 9.0
- 整体挺拔度 / Posture Presence：6.2 → 8.8

请使用进度条、雷达图或对比数字卡片呈现，视觉清楚但不要夸张。

【曲线与比例分析区】
请绘制轻量线条图或人体轮廓曲线示意，展示：
- 颈肩线条
- 背部曲线
- 腰腹线条
- 骨盆角度趋势
- 腿部垂直线
- 正面左右平衡感

线条要像专业体态评估图，不能像医疗诊断图，不能制造恐吓感。

【穿搭优化建议区】
请展示 3 套适合 After 状态的日常穿搭方案。每套包含小缩略图、风格关键词和一句理由：

Look 01：通勤显稳重
关键词：直线廓形、深浅分层、外套修饰肩背
理由：通过外套肩线与直筒下装，弱化腹部前顶感，增强纵向比例。

Look 02：周末轻运动
关键词：功能面料、微宽松、上短下长
理由：提高舒适度，同时让身体线条更放松、更舒展。

Look 03：城市轻潮
关键词：短外套、高腰线、利落鞋型
理由：提升视觉重心，让整体更挺拔、更年轻、更有精神。

【行动建议区】
请增加一个小模块「7天体态重启建议 / 7-Day Posture Reset」，内容温和、可执行：
- 每天 3 分钟下巴回收练习
- 每天 5 分钟胸椎打开
- 每天 5 分钟髋屈肌拉伸
- 每天 10 次臀桥激活
- 站立时避免膝盖锁死
- 拍照时保持脚掌稳定、肋骨回收、肩颈放松

请注意，这些建议只能作为日常姿态管理建议，不要写成治疗方案。

【底部总结】
请用一句温和、有力量的话总结：
“这不是一夜变瘦，而是通过姿态校准、重心调整和穿搭线条管理，让同一个身体呈现出更舒展、更挺拔、更自信的状态。”

cases.prompt:
英文提示词:
Premium automotive collector poster for the Lamborghini Revuelto, futuristic magazine-style infographic layout, clean light stone or soft matte gray background, ultra-luxury exotic supercar advertisement aesthetic, combining photoreal car imagery, technical linework, aerospace-inspired graphic details, and premium modern typography. Cinematic lighting, ultra-crisp rendering, dramatic yet clean composition, 2:3 vertical format, collector-grade visual balance.

Hero visual:
A full three-quarter front view of a Lamborghini Revuelto in vivid Verde Scandal or metallic Arancio orange, featuring its sharp Y-shaped lighting signature, sculpted hybrid-era bodywork, large side intakes, angular hood surfaces, and aggressive stance. The car sits on a dark high-end studio track surface with subtle reflections. Background elements hint at a futuristic mountain road or private supercar test route. The design should radiate modern power, exotic engineering, and theatrical presence.

Layout structure (top to bottom):
1. Header:
Top-left Lamborghini bull emblem and "Lamborghini" wordmark.
Large title: "REVUELTO"
Subtitle: "V12 REBORN. ELECTRIFIED FURY."
Top-right tagline:
"The first HPEV V12 Lamborghini. A new beast begins."
Include a short descriptive paragraph emphasizing the Revuelto as Lamborghini’s new flagship and the reinvention of the V12 era through hybrid performance.

2. Technical design layer:
Use faint blueprint sketches of the Revuelto side profile, rear diffuser, and chassis layout in the background. Include subtle line-art diagrams of the hybrid system, battery tunnel layout, and V12 engine placement. Add small angular technical overlays inspired by aerospace interfaces.

3. Performance stats bar:
Below the hero car, include a sleek horizontal stat section:
- Powertrain: "6.5L Naturally Aspirated V12 + 3 Electric Motors"
- Combined Output: "1,001 CV"
- 0-100 km/h: "2.5 s"
- Top Speed: "350+ KM/H"
- Transmission: "8-Speed Dual-Clutch"
- Architecture: "HPEV Carbon Fiber Monofuselage"

4. Secondary views:
Two smaller visuals:
- rear three-quarter angle with taillights and diffuser
- cockpit or front detail close-up
Between them, a dramatic central quote:
"Not evolution. Detonation."

5. Heritage timeline:
Bottom strip showing Lamborghini flagship V12 lineage:
- Countach
- Diablo
- Murciélago
- Aventador
- Revuelto
Each labeled with years and model names in a refined linear timeline.

6. Footer:
Left-side quote:
"A Lamborghini should look like speed even when standing still."
Right-side text block:
"DRAMA. INNOVATION. DOMINANCE."
Add a compact technical note about the hybrid V12 philosophy.

Color palette:
Light stone gray background, vivid green or orange hero car, black typography, subtle neon-lime or bronze accents, carbon-fiber gray.

Typography:
Bold geometric sans-serif, sharp modern display type, clean premium body copy, with a high-tech luxury presentation.

Style notes:
The poster should feel aggressive, futuristic, elegant, and unmistakably Lamborghini. It should look like a premium launch poster mixed with a collector’s engineering infographic.

中文提示词:
兰博基尼 Revuelto 的高端汽车收藏版海报，未来感杂志风格的信息图表布局，干净浅色调石头或柔和哑光灰色背景，超豪华异国情调超跑广告美学，结合真实感汽车图像、技术线条、航空航天启发的图形细节和高端现代排版。电影级光照，超清晰渲染，戏剧性但干净的构图，2:3 垂直格式，收藏级视觉平衡。

一辆兰博基尼 Revuelto 的完整四分之三前视图，呈现鲜艳的 Verde Scandal 绿色或金属 Arancio 橙色，具有锋利的 Y 型照明标志、雕刻般的混动时代车身、大型侧进气口、有棱角的前盖表面和激进的姿态。汽车停在深色高端工作室赛道表面上，带有微妙的反射。背景元素暗示了未来的山路或私人超跑测试路线。设计应散发出现代力量、异国情调的工程和戏剧性的存在感。

布局结构（从上到下）：
1. 页眉：
左上角兰博基尼公牛标志和“Lamborghini”文字标志。
大标题："REVUELTO"
副标题："V12 REBORN. ELECTRIFIED FURY."
右上角标语：
"The first HPEV V12 Lamborghini. A new beast begins."
包含一个简短的描述性段落，强调 Revuelto 作为兰博基尼的新旗舰，以及通过混合动力性能对 V12 时代的重新定义。

2. 技术设计层：
在背景中使用 Revuelto 侧面轮廓、后扩散器和底盘布局的淡蓝色草图。包含混合动力系统、电池隧道布局和 V12 发动机位置的微妙线条艺术图。添加受航空航天界面启发的小型有棱角的技术覆盖层。

3. 性能参数条：
在主视觉汽车下方，包含一个流畅的水平参数部分：
- 动力系统："6.5L Naturally Aspirated V12 + 3 Electric Motors"
- 综合输出："1,001 CV"
- 0-100 km/h："2.5 s"
- 最高时速："350+ KM/H"
- 变速箱："8-Speed Dual-Clutch"
- 架构："HPEV Carbon Fiber Monofuselage"

4. 辅助视图：
两个较小的视觉效果：
- 带有尾灯和扩散器的后部四分之三角度
- 座舱或前部细节特写
在它们之间，一个戏剧性的中央引言：
"Not evolution. Detonation."

5. 传承时间线：
底部条带显示兰博基尼旗舰 V12 血统：
- Countach
- Diablo
- Murciélago
- Aventador
- Revuelto
每一个都标有年份和型号名称，呈现在精致的线性时间线中。

6. 页脚：
左侧引言：
"A Lamborghini should look like speed even when standing still."
右侧文本块：
"DRAMA. INNOVATION. DOMINANCE."
添加一段关于混合动力 V12 理念的紧凑技术说明。

调色板：
浅色调石头灰背景，鲜艳的绿色或橙色主视觉汽车，黑色排版，微妙的霓虹柠檬绿或古铜色点缀，碳纤维灰。

排版：
粗体几何无衬线字体，锋利的现代展示字体，干净的高端正文副本，具有高科技豪华的呈现效果。

风格说明：
海报应该给人一种激进、未来感、优雅且毫无疑问是兰博基尼的感觉。它应该看起来像一张高端发布海报与收藏家工程信息图的结合。

cases.title: 黑白光学抽象概念海报设计
cases.imageAlt: 黑白光学抽象概念海报设计
cases.prompt:
英文提示词:
Please create a high-completion "Monochrome Optical Concept Poster" based on the user-input [Theme Text] and [Image Ratio].
[User Input]
Theme Text: [Custom]
Image Ratio: [Custom according to needs]
This is not an ordinary text poster, nor a simple layout poster, nor a figurative illustration, but a high-completion concept poster with the "Theme Text" as the core, integrating "Black and White Op Art", "Parametric Generative Graphics", "Biomorphic Abstraction", and "Experimental Swiss Style Typography". The overall look must have a strong visual impact, modern design sense, abstraction, orderliness, philosophical feel, and a unified series style.
[Overall Style Requirements]
1. The overall adopts black and white monochrome as the main tone, with a background of clean light cream white, warm white, or extremely light gray paper texture.
2. The main visual of the image should present a high-contrast abstract graphic language, combining elements such as optical illusion, mirror symmetry, ripples, repeated curves, parametric arcs, radial lines, moiré patterns, concentric lines, dot matrices, checkerboard deformations, fluid forms, feather-like or wing-like structures, nodes, circuits, paths, and energy fields.
3. The graphics cannot just be decorative; they must form a semantic echo with the [Theme Text]: making the abstract graphics look like they are "explaining" the emotion, structure, tension, or relationship of this theme.
4. The style should lean towards high-end graphic design, experimental posters, futuristic visual archives, design exhibition posters, and conceptual album cover vibes, avoiding commercial promotional feel, cheap feel, and ordinary social media template feel.
[Main Title Requirements]
1. Use the [Theme Text] as the most important main title of the entire poster, placed in the center or core visual area of the image, with a large font size, strong recognition, and strong visual dominance.
2. The main title must be rendered accurately, without typos, missing characters, or incorrect characters.
3. If the [Theme Text] is in Chinese, the Chinese main title shall prevail, and a small English subtitle or English explanation can be automatically added as supplementary information; if the [Theme Text] is in English, the English main title shall prevail, and a smaller line of Chinese supplementary explanation can be automatically added.
4. The font style of the main title should be modern, restrained, and powerful, suitable for high-end design posters, without cartoonish feel or excessive flashiness.
[Composition and Visual Structure Requirements]
1. The image should have a clear "central order", and it is recommended to adopt one of the following structures, automatically judging the most suitable method based on the theme:
   - Symmetric Confrontation
   - Central Axis Explosion
   - Bidirectional Collision
   - Resonant Aggregation
   - Node Path
   - Vortex Circuit
   - Ritual Exhibition
2. If the theme leans towards "conflict, confrontation, gaming, scrambling, dilemma, historical tension", visual structures such as left-right clashing, dual-core confrontation, central collision, splitting, and pulling can be adopted.
3. If the theme leans towards "integration, symbiosis, resonance, connection, harmony, order", visual structures such as mirror echoing, centripetal convergence, ripple resonance, and structural interlocking can be adopted.
4. If the theme leans towards "speculation, cognition, system, decision-making, philosophy, mechanism", visual organization methods such as nodes, connecting lines, circuits, paths, balanced structures, and parametric diagram feel can be adopted.
5. The main abstract graphic should be strong enough to become the recognition symbol of the poster alone, but it must not overwhelm the main title.
[Typography and Information Hierarchy Requirements]
1. In addition to the main title, a small amount of auxiliary typography information can be added to the image to enhance the "archival feel / exhibition feel / conceptual feel", for example:
   - Small English keywords
   - Small Chinese keywords
   - Vertical side notes
   - Short navigation-style words at the top or bottom
   - Short slogans
   - Structural labels
   - Symbolic explanatory text
2. These auxiliary information should be automatically generated around the theme; the content should be short, small, and refined, without large paragraphs of explanation, and not like article typography.
3. Appropriately add dots, lines, crosses, asterisks, rings, grids, coordinate-like symbols, minimalist icons, to enhance the systematic feel and experimental feel.
4. The layout should have a breathing feel and white space, and cannot be too crowded; at the same time, there must be enough information density to form a high-end visual effect of "strong design sense but not cluttered".
[Theme Translation Logic Requirements]
1. You cannot just put the theme text on and finish; you must transform the [Theme Text] into a visual metaphor.
2. For example:
   - If the theme has a sense of conflict, the graphics should reflect pulling, confrontation, collision, fission, imbalance, oppression, and battlefield feel.
   - If the theme has a sense of integration, the graphics should reflect convergence, echo, flow, interlocking, resonance, connection, and balance.
   - If the theme has a sense of dilemma or gaming, the graphics should reflect bifurcation, choice, nodes, balance, paths, tension, and loops.
   - If the theme has a sense of history or epic, the graphics can introduce abstract expressions of artifacts, patterns, ritual feel, and power feel, but still need to maintain a modern black and white experimental design style.
3. The abstract graphics should look like "the form after the concept has been visualized", rather than random patterns.
[Image Texture Requirements]
1. The texture leans towards graphic design and high-end printing visuals, with black and white being clean and crisp, and clear edges.
2. Subtle paper texture, faint noise, and printing feel can be appropriately added, but do not over-retro.
3. The overall should look like a poster that can be directly used for:
   - Exhibition posters
   - Viewpoint covers
   - Design-focused feature covers
   - Conceptual visual posters
   - Cultural and ideological cover images
4. Avoid generating realistic characters, real scene photography, cartoon illustrations, colorful commercial advertising styles, and juvenile graphic languages.
[Final Output Requirements]
Please output a concept poster with complete composition, prominent main title, strong abstract graphics, high-end typography, unified black and white, and a sense of series and collectibility.
Make sure that the [Theme Text] is accurate and clear, the overall style is unified, and the image has strong characteristics of "Optical Abstraction + Conceptual Typography + Modern Design Poster".

图片比例：【根据需求自定义】 

这不是普通文字海报，不是简单排版海报，也不是具象插画，而是一张以“主题文字”为核心、融合「黑白光学艺术 / Op Art」「参数化生成图形」「生物形态抽象」「实验性瑞士风排版」的高完成度概念海报。整体必须具有强烈的视觉冲击力、现代设计感、抽象性、秩序感、哲学感和系列化统一风格。

【整体风格要求】
1. 整体采用黑白单色为主，背景为干净的浅米白、暖白或极浅灰纸面质感。
2. 画面主视觉应呈现高对比度的抽象图形语言，结合光学错觉、镜像对称、波纹、重复曲线、参数化弧线、放射线、莫尔纹、同心线、点阵、棋盘格变形、流体形态、羽毛状或翼状结构、节点、回路、路径、能量场等元素。
3. 图形不能只是装饰，要与【主题文字】形成语义呼应：让抽象图形像是在“解释”这个主题的情绪、结构、张力或关系。
4. 风格应偏高级平面设计、实验海报、未来感视觉档案、设计展海报、概念专辑封面气质，避免商业促销感、廉价感和普通社媒模板感。

【主标题要求】
1. 将【主题文字】作为整张海报最重要的主标题，放在画面中心或核心视觉区域，字号大、识别强、视觉统治力强。
2. 主标题必须准确渲染，不能出现错字、漏字、别字。
3. 若【主题文字】为中文，则以中文大标题为主，可自动补充一个小型英文副标题或英文解释作为辅助信息；若【主题文字】为英文，则英文主标题为主，可自动补充一行较小的中文辅助说明。
4. 主标题字体风格应现代、克制、有力量感，适合高端设计海报，不要卡通感，不要过度花哨。

【构图与视觉结构要求】
1. 画面应具有明确的“中心秩序”，推荐采用以下结构之一，并根据主题自动判断最适合的方式：
   - 对称对峙式
   - 中轴爆发式
   - 双向碰撞式
   - 共振聚合式
   - 节点路径式
   - 漩涡回路式
   - 仪式展陈式
2. 如果主题偏“冲突、对抗、博弈、争夺、困境、历史张力”，可采用左右对冲、双核对峙、中心碰撞、分裂与拉扯的视觉结构。
3. 如果主题偏“融合、共生、共振、连接、和谐、秩序”，可采用镜像呼应、向心汇聚、波纹共鸣、结构互嵌的视觉结构。
4. 如果主题偏“思辨、认知、系统、决策、哲学、机制”，可采用节点、连线、回路、路径、均衡结构、参数图示感的视觉组织方式。
5. 主体抽象图形应足够强，能单独成为海报的识别符号，但不要喧宾夺主压过主标题。

【排版与信息层级要求】
1. 除主标题外，可在画面中加入少量辅助排版信息，用于增强“档案感 / 展览感 / 概念感”，例如：
   - 小号英文关键词
   - 小号中文关键词
   - 竖排边注
   - 顶部或底部导航式短词
   - 简短口号
   - 结构标签
   - 符号化说明文字
2. 这些辅助信息应围绕主题自动生成，内容要短、小、精，不要大段说明，不要像文章排版。
3. 可适度加入点、线、十字、星号、圆环、网格、坐标感符号、极简图标等，提升系统感与实验感。
4. 版式要有呼吸感与留白，不能过于拥挤；同时又要有足够的信息密度，形成“设计感强但不杂乱”的高级视觉效果。

【主题翻译逻辑要求】
1. 不能只把主题文字放上去就结束，而要将【主题文字】转化为视觉隐喻。
2. 例如：
   - 若主题具有冲突感，图形应体现拉扯、对峙、碰撞、裂变、失衡、压迫、战场感。
   - 若主题具有融合感，图形应体现汇聚、回响、流动、互嵌、共鸣、联结、平衡感。
   - 若主题具有困境或博弈感，图形应体现分叉、选择、节点、均衡、路径、张力、循环。
   - 若主题具有历史或史诗感，图形可引入器物、纹样、仪式感、权力感的抽象化表达，但仍需保持现代黑白实验设计风格。
3. 抽象图形应看起来像“概念被可视化后的形态”，而不是随机花纹。

【画面质感要求】
1. 质感偏平面设计与高级印刷视觉，黑白干净利落，边缘清晰。
2. 可适当加入细微纸感、微弱噪点、印刷感，但不要做旧过头。
3. 整体应像一张可以直接用于：
   - 展览海报
   - 观点封面
   - 设计感专题封面
   - 概念视觉海报
   - 文化与思想类封面图
4. 避免生成写实人物、真实场景摄影、卡通插画、彩色商业广告风、低幼图形语言。

【最终输出要求】
请输出一张构图完整、主标题醒目、抽象图形强烈、排版高级、黑白统一、具有系列感与收藏感的概念海报。
务必确保【主题文字】准确清晰，整体风格统一，画面具有强烈的“光学抽象 + 概念排版 + 现代设计海报”特征。

cases.title: 专业书籍内页排版设计
cases.imageAlt: 专业书籍内页排版设计
cases.prompt:
英文提示词:
You are a professional book designer, visual editor, image analyst, and teaching content planner.

The user will upload an image. You need to first carefully analyze the content, style, theme, purpose, knowledge attributes, and possible book type of this image, then generate a complete book interior page layout design based on this image. The final image must look like a certain page from a real publication, not an ordinary poster, promotional image, PPT, or social media layout.

Your task is to determine "what this book is likely about" based on the image, and design a book interior page around this image that has learning value, reading hierarchy, a sense of publication, and can be directly printed and used. After analysis, please directly generate the final book interior page image, do not generate any copy for the user.

1. First analyze the image content and book attributes

Before generating the page, please first understand the image uploaded by the user, including but not limited to:

What is the main subject of this image.
What category of content it belongs to: photography, painting, design, architecture, fashion, film, art history, nature observation, product design, figure study, travel, humanities documentary, craftsmanship, illustration, visual training, professional tutorials, etc.
What type of book this image is most likely to appear in: photography learning books, painting technique books, art appreciation books, design textbooks, portfolios, architectural space analysis books, visual composition textbooks, color research books, humanities documentary books, nature illustrated guides, film shot analysis books, other more suitable book types

Determine what is most worth explaining about this image: composition, light and shadow, color, space, perspective, brushstrokes, texture, emotion, narrative, technique, style, symbolic meaning, visual rhythm, character relationships, picture structure, creative method

Based on the image content, automatically infer what function this book interior page is most suitable to serve: case analysis page, technique breakdown page, work appreciation page, teaching demonstration page, image research page, visual composition analysis page, creative step explanation page, key knowledge summary page, comparative observation page, exercise guidance page

2. Page content planning

Please plan which sections this page should contain based on the image content. Do not use fixed templates; decide intelligently based on the image itself.

It may include but is not limited to the following sections:

Page main title
Use a concise, publication-style title to summarize the theme of this page. The title should be like a real book chapter title, not advertising copy.

Subtitle or introduction
Use a short paragraph of text to explain why this image is worth analyzing, or what is mainly learned on this page.

Main image display area
The uploaded image should become the core visual content of the page. According to layout needs, it can be displayed completely, or partially enlarged, cropped, or displayed with white space, but the recognizability and aesthetics of the image must be maintained.

Image analysis area
Extract several key observation points based on the image content, for example: composition method, light direction, color relationship, spatial layers, visual focus, technique characteristics, emotional expression, creative logic

Annotation description area
You can add thin lines, numbers, arrows, partial frame selections, annotation labels, etc. around the image to point out important details in the image. Annotations must be restrained, accurate, and design-oriented, not cluttered.

Partial enlargement area
If there are details worth learning in the image, you can set one or more partial enlargement frames to display brushstrokes, textures, light and shadow, composition details, character movements, materials, spatial relationships, etc.
Method summary area
Use short items to summarize the methods, patterns, or learnable aspects behind this image.

Exercise prompt area
If suitable, you can add a small exercise task, for example: try recropping this image and observe the visual focus changes. Copy the light-dark relationship in it. Analyze the main color, secondary color, and accent color. Use three lines to summarize the composition structure of the picture. Try to shoot or draw another work with the same composition.

Page number, chapter number, column name
You can add a small number of publication details, such as chapter numbers, page numbers, column titles, caption numbers, etc., to make the page more like a real book interior page.

3. Content generation principles
The text content on the page must be generated based on image analysis, it cannot be vague, and professional terms cannot be randomly piled up.

If the image is a photography work, you should focus on analyzing:

Composition method 2. Lens perspective 3. Light direction 4. Light-dark relationship 5. Color tendency 6. Depth of field and focus 7. Moment capture 8. Narrative sense and viewing path
If the image is a painting work, you should focus on analyzing:

Composition structure 2. Color relationship 3. Brushstrokes and texture 4. Light-dark shaping 5. Space handling 6. Modeling language 7. Style characteristics 8. Emotional expression 9. Copying or learning methods
If the image is a design work, you should focus on analyzing:

Layout structure 2. Font relationship 3. Color system 4. Information hierarchy 5. Visual rhythm 6. Brand temperament 7. Image-text relationship 8. Borrowable design methods
If the image is architecture or space, you should focus on analyzing:

Spatial structure 2. Perspective relationship 3. Light entry method 4. Material contrast 5. Block relationship 6. Scale of people and space 7. Sense of order and circulation
If the image is nature, travel, or documentary content, you should focus on analyzing:

Location atmosphere 2. Humanities background 3. Picture narrative 4. Natural form 5. Color and seasonal sense 6. Observation method 7. Visual recording value

4. Layout design requirements
The generated image must be a high-quality book interior page, not a poster.

Overall requirements:

Suitable for printing. 2. The layout is clean, restrained, and professional. 3. There is a clear reading order. 4. The image-text ratio is reasonable. 5. The text cannot be too much, nor empty. 6. The page must have the texture of a real publication. 7. It cannot look like a PPT. 8. It cannot look like an e-commerce detail page. 9. It cannot look like a social media long image. 10. It cannot look like a cluttered infographic. 11. Do not over-decorate. 12. All elements must serve the purpose of image analysis and learning.

Preferably adopt the following layout directions:

Book interior page grid layout. Left image right text, or top image bottom text, or large image with sidebar annotations. Clear hierarchy of titles, subtitles, body text, captions, annotations, and page numbers. Large areas of white space. Exquisite thin lines, numbers, columns, marginal notes. Low saturation, readable, print-suitable color scheme. Font style should have a sense of publication, academic feel, or art book temperament. The image area should be prominent, and the text area should assist understanding.

5. Visual style requirements

The overall visual style should be automatically selected based on the image content, but must maintain a high-end, restrained, real publication texture.

You can refer to the following styles:

Art textbook interior page 2. Photography book interior page 3. Painting technique book interior page 4. Visual design textbook 5. Art museum publication 6. Architecture magazine interior page 7. Portfolio analysis page 8. High-end art catalog 9. Modern editorial design 10. Minimalist academic publication

The image should have:

Clear grid system. 2. Stable type area. 3. Reasonable page margins. 4. Delicate image-text relationship. 5. Restrained decorative elements. 6. Precise visual annotations. 7. Readable body text layout. 8. Print-suitable clarity.

6. Text layout requirements

The main title should be clear and summarizing. 2. The subtitle should be short, explaining the learning focus of this page. 3. The body text should not be too long; it should be like analytical text in a real book. 4. Annotation text should be short and accurate. 5. Each section title should be clear. 6. Do not use exaggerated marketing language. 7. Do not use empty adjectives. 8. Do not appear meaningless placeholder text. 9. The text should be like content written by a professional editor, not randomly generated explanations by AI. 10. All text must be related to the image content.

7. Relationship between image and content

The uploaded image must be the core of this page.

You need to build a complete page around this image, not treat the image as decorative material.

The image can be used for:

Main image display 2. Partial enlargement 3. Structure analysis 4. Color extraction 5. Composition wireframe 6. Detail annotation 7. Technique breakdown 8. Learning case

But do not excessively destroy the original image. Analysis lines, annotations, cropping, and enlargement should all serve to understand the image.

8. Printability requirements

The final generated result must be suitable for direct printing as a book interior page.

Please follow these requirements:

The page ratio is suitable for a book interior page. 2. Prioritize vertical page format. 3. A4, A5, 16mo, or ratios close to publication interior pages can be adopted. 4. The resolution should be clear. 5. The text should be clearly readable. 6. Image edges, titles, and body text should not be too close to the page edges. 7. Safe margins should be kept around the page. 8. The layout should not be too full, to avoid appearing crowded after printing. 9. The overall look should be like a formal book page that has already completed editorial design. 10. The final page should have the completeness to be directly placed in a book, textbook, portfolio, or art catalog.

9. Final generation goal

Please generate a professional book interior page layout based on the image uploaded by the user.

This page should achieve the following effects:

At a glance, it can be seen that it belongs to a certain type of professional book. 2. It can be seen why this image is placed on this page. 3. The page is not only good-looking but also has analysis, learning, or appreciation value. 4. There is a clear relationship between the image, title, body text, annotations, and partial details. 5. The layout is like a real publication, not a temporary design draft. 6. The user can directly print it out and use it as a certain page in a book. 7. The page has a professional, restrained, clear, readable, and collectible publication temperament.

10. User optional custom area

Please have the user upload an image
Page number:
Page size:
Text language:
Whether partial enlargement is needed:
Whether image annotation is needed:
Other supplementary information:

中文提示词:
你是一名专业书籍设计师、视觉编辑、图像分析师和教学内容策划师。

用户会上传一张图片。你需要先认真分析这张图片的内容、风格、主题、用途、知识属性与可能所属的书籍类型，然后基于这张图片生成一张完整的书籍内页排版设计。最终画面必须像真实出版物中的某一页，而不是普通海报、宣传图、PPT 或社交媒体排版。

你的任务是根据图片判断“这本书可能在讲什么”，并围绕这张图片设计出一页有学习价值、有阅读层次、有出版感、可直接打印使用的书籍内页。分析完后请直接生成最终书籍内页画面，不要给用户生成任何文案。

一、先分析图片内容与书籍属性

在生成页面之前，请先理解用户上传的图片，包括但不限于：

这张图片的主体是什么。
它属于哪一类内容：摄影、绘画、设计、建筑、时尚、电影、艺术史、自然观察、产品设计、人物研究、旅行、人文纪实、手工艺、插画、视觉训练、专业教程等。
这张图片最可能出现在什么类型的书籍中：摄影学习书籍 绘画技法书籍 艺术赏析书籍 设计教材 作品集 建筑空间分析书籍 视觉构成教材 色彩研究书籍 人文纪实书籍 自然图鉴 电影镜头分析书籍 其他更适合的书籍类型

判断这张图片最值得被讲解的地方是什么：构图 光影 色彩 空间 透视 笔触 材质 情绪 叙事 技法 风格 象征意义 视觉节奏 人物关系 画面结构 创作方法

根据图片内容，自动推断这一页书籍内页最适合承担什么功能：案例分析页 技法拆解页 作品赏析页 教学示范页 图像研究页 视觉构成分析页 创作步骤说明页 重点知识总结页 对比观察页 练习引导页

二、页面内容规划

请根据图片内容，自动规划这一页应该包含哪些板块。不要使用固定模板，要根据图片本身智能决定。

可以包含但不限于以下板块：

页面主标题
用一句简洁、有出版感的标题概括这一页的主题。标题要像真实书籍章节标题，而不是广告文案。

副标题或导语
用一小段文字说明这张图片为什么值得分析，或者这一页主要学习什么。

图片主体展示区
上传图片应成为页面中的核心视觉内容。根据版式需要，可以完整展示，也可以局部放大、裁切、留白展示，但必须保持图片的识别度和美感。

图像分析区
根据图片内容提炼出几个关键观察点，例如：构图方式 光线方向 色彩关系 空间层次 视觉焦点 技法特点 情绪表达 创作逻辑

标注说明区
可以在图片周围加入细线、编号、箭头、局部框选、注释标签等，用来指出图片中的重要细节。标注必须克制、准确、有设计感，不能杂乱。

局部放大区
如果图片中有值得学习的细节，可以设置一个或多个局部放大框，用于展示笔触、纹理、光影、构图细节、人物动作、材质、空间关系等。
方法总结区
用简短条目总结这张图片背后的方法、规律或可学习之处。

练习提示区
如果适合，可以加入一个小型练习任务，例如：试着重新裁切这张图片，观察视觉焦点变化。临摹其中的明暗关系。分析主色、辅助色和点缀色。用三条线概括画面的构图结构。尝试用相同构图拍摄或绘制另一张作品。

页码、章节编号、栏目名
可以加入少量出版物细节，例如章节编号、页码、栏目标题、图注编号等，让页面更像真实书籍内页。

三、内容生成原则
页面中的文字内容必须基于图片分析生成，不能空泛、不能随便堆砌专业词。

如果图片是摄影作品，应重点分析：

构图方式 2. 镜头视角 3. 光线方向 4. 明暗关系 5. 色彩倾向 6. 景深与焦点 7. 瞬间捕捉 8. 叙事感与观看路径
如果图片是绘画作品，应重点分析：

构图结构 2. 色彩关系 3. 笔触与肌理 4. 明暗塑造 5. 空间处理 6. 造型语言 7. 风格特征 8. 情绪表达 9. 临摹或学习方法
如果图片是设计作品，应重点分析：

版式结构 2. 字体关系 3. 色彩系统 4. 信息层级 5. 视觉节奏 6. 品牌气质 7. 图文关系 8. 可借鉴的设计方法
如果图片是建筑或空间，应重点分析：

空间结构 2. 透视关系 3. 光线进入方式 4. 材质对比 5. 体块关系 6. 人与空间的尺度 7. 秩序感与动线
如果图片是自然、旅行或纪实内容，应重点分析：

地点氛围 2. 人文背景 3. 画面叙事 4. 自然形态 5. 色彩与季节感 6. 观察方法 7. 视觉记录价值

四、版式设计要求
生成的画面必须是高质量书籍内页，而不是海报。

整体要求：

适合打印。2. 版面干净、克制、专业。3. 有明确的阅读顺序。4. 图文比例合理。5. 文字不能过多，也不能空洞。6. 页面要有真实出版物的质感。7. 不能像PPT。8. 不能像电商详情页。9. 不能像社交媒体长图。10. 不能像杂乱的信息图。11. 不要过度装饰。12. 所有元素都必须服务于图片分析与学习目的。

优先采用以下版式方向：

书籍内页式网格排版。左图右文，或上图下文，或大图加边栏注释。清晰的标题、副标题、正文、图注、标注、页码层级。大面积留白。精致的细线、编号、分栏、边注。低饱和、耐读、适合印刷的配色。字体风格应具有出版感、学术感或艺术书气质。图片区域应突出，文字区域应辅助理解。

五、视觉风格要求

整体视觉风格应根据图片内容自动选择，但必须保持高级、克制、真实出版物质感。

可以参考以下风格：

艺术教材内页 2. 摄影书内页 3. 绘画技法书内页 4. 视觉设计教材 5. 美术馆出版物 6. 建筑杂志内页 7. 作品集分析页 8. 高级艺术图录 9. 现代编辑设计 10. 极简学术出版物

画面应具有：

清晰的网格系统。2. 稳定的版心。3. 合理页边距。4. 细腻的图文关系。5. 克制的装饰元素。6. 精准的视觉标注。7. 可阅读的正文排版。8. 可打印的清晰度。

六、文字排版要求

主标题要清晰、有概括力。2. 副标题要简短，解释这一页的学习重点。3. 正文不要太长，要像真实书籍中的分析文字。4. 标注文字要短小准确。5. 每个板块标题要清楚。6. 不要使用夸张营销语。7. 不要使用空洞形容词。8. 不要出现无意义的占位文字。9. 文字应该像专业编辑写出的内容，而不是AI随便生成的说明。10. 所有文字必须与图片内容有关。

七、图片与内容的关系

上传的图片必须是这一页的核心。

你需要围绕这张图片建立完整页面，而不是把图片当成装饰素材。

图片可以被用于：

主图展示 2. 局部放大 3. 结构分析 4. 色彩提取 5. 构图线框 6. 细节标注 7. 技法拆解 8. 学习案例

但不要过度破坏原图。分析线、标注、裁切、放大都应该服务于理解图片。

八、可打印要求

最终生成结果必须适合作为书籍内页直接打印。

请遵守以下要求：

页面比例适合书籍内页。2. 优先使用竖版页面。3. 可采用 A4、A5、16开或接近出版物内页的比例。4. 分辨率清晰。5. 文字清楚可读。6. 图片边缘、标题、正文不要贴得太靠近页面边缘。7. 页面四周应保留安全边距。8. 排版不能过满，避免印刷后显得拥挤。9. 整体要像已经完成编辑设计的正式书页。10. 最终页面应具备直接放入书籍、教材、作品集或艺术图录中的完成度。

九、最终生成目标

请基于用户上传的图片，生成一张专业书籍内页排版。

这张页面应达到以下效果：

一眼看出它属于某类专业书籍。2. 能看出这张图片为什么被放在这一页中。3. 页面不仅好看，而且具有分析、学习或赏析价值。4. 图像、标题、正文、标注、局部细节之间有清晰关系。5. 版式像真实出版物，而不是临时设计稿。6. 用户可以直接打印出来，作为书籍中的某一页使用。7. 页面具有专业、克制、清晰、耐读、可收藏的出版气质。

十、用户可选自定义区

请用户上传图片
页码：
页面尺寸：
文字语言：
是否需要局部放大：
是否需要图像标注：
其他补充信息：

cases.prompt:
英文提示词:
Analyze the uploaded image and preserve the original subject, composition, and lighting. Do not alter the identity or structure of the main subject. Add playful, hand-drawn doodles that interact directly with the subject in the image. The doodles should mimic, follow, or exaggerate the shapes, gestures, or motion present-such as outlining poses, extending limbs, adding motion lines, or creating imaginative elements that

"respond" to the subject.

Ensure the doodles feel naturally integrated into the scene, as if they were drawn on top of the photo with intention.

Use a sketchy, imperfect, hand-drawn style with organic lines, slightly uneven strokes, and a casual illustrated feel.

Include whimsical handwritten text elements placed around the image. The text should match the mood or implied context of the scene, with a playful and spontaneous tone.

Avoid fixed phrases-generate context-aware, creative, and humorous text that fits each unique image. Maintain a balanced composition so the doodles enhance the image without overwhelming the original subject. Keep the overall aesthetic fun, expressive, and social-media-ready. High resolution, clean overlay, vibrant yet natural color harmony.

中文提示词:

避免使用固定短语——生成符合每个独特图像的语境感知、富有创意和幽默的文本。保持平衡的构图，以便涂鸦增强图像而不会淹没原始主体。保持整体美学有趣、富有表现力，并适合社交媒体发布。高分辨率，干净的叠加层，鲜艳但自然的色彩和谐。

cases.title: 餐饮品牌商业促销海报
cases.imageAlt: 餐饮品牌商业促销海报
cases.prompt:
英文提示词:
Based on the food image uploaded by the user, create a highly polished "Food Hero Explainer Poster" suitable for social media publishing and food brand promotion.

【User Input】
Brand Name: [Enter Brand Name]
Brand Subtitle / Slogan: [Enter a Short Slogan]
Product Name: [Enter Product Name]
Product Category: [Fast Food / Main Dish / Beverage / Dessert / Local Cuisine / Baking / Light Meal / Other]
Left Ingredient List: [Enter 4–6 Main Ingredients, Each with a Short Description]
Right Selling Point List: [Enter 4–5 Nutritional or Product Selling Points, Each with a Short Description]
Price: [Enter Price]
Price Unit: [Per Serving / Per Cup / Per Box / PER SERVING / PER CUP / PER BOX]
Button Text: [Order Now / Buy Now / Place Order Now / ORDER NOW / BUY NOW]
Bottom Guide Text: [e.g.: More New Products | Promotions | Brand Updates / Get New Product and Discount Info / Follow for More Benefits]
Bottom Platform Icon Combination: [e.g.: Douyin + Xiaohongshu + Video Account + Official Account; or Douyin + Xiaohongshu + Meituan + Dianping]
Bottom Search Guide: [e.g.: Search Across All Platforms: Brand Name / Search Brand Name: XXXX]
Accent Color: [e.g. Orange / Red / Golden Yellow / Green / Strawberry Pink / Black Gold Orange]
Aspect Ratio: [Portrait 2:3]

【Core Reference Rules】
Image A is the main food reference image uploaded by the user, and also the core main visual basis for this poster.
Must strictly preserve the food's type, main appearance, overall structure, core plating method, main ingredient expression, color tendency, and realistic texture.
Do not replace this dish with another food, do not regenerate a different dish, do not change to a different plating logic, do not make the food look distorted.
While maintaining consistency of the main subject, moderately optimize lighting, clarity, shadow layers, spatial sense, and commercial photography texture to make it look more like professional food photography in high-end restaurant advertisements, but cannot change the product itself.
The key point is: preserve the original dish's recognizability, only upgrade the poster packaging, layout design, and overall visual presentation.

【Overall Positioning】
This is not an ordinary menu image, nor purely food photography, but a commercial promotional poster integrating "high-end restaurant brand advertisement + food main visual + ingredient explanation + selling point information bar + price conversion zone".
The overall temperament should present premium, clean, modern, polished, appetizing, realistic, professional food advertisement, suitable for new product promotion, delivery platform display, brand promotion, social media publishing, and restaurant single-item advertisement.

【Background and Overall Style】
Use soft warm off-white, cream white, light warm beige as the background, overall clean and simple, with a slight premium paper texture or soft studio shooting spatial sense.
The image should have comfortable white space, balanced layout, fresh visual feel, reflecting modern restaurant brand sense, light luxury menu sense, and high-completion commercial advertisement sense.
Do not use complex backgrounds, do not over-decorate, do not have a cheap feel, do not have cluttered colors interfering with the main subject.

【Layout Structure】
Adopt a stable portrait center composition, with clear information zoning, distinct primary and secondary elements, and a natural overall reading path:

1. Top Brand Zone
- Place a clean brand logo / small icon centered at the top
- Below is the brand name
- Further below is a brand subtitle / slogan
- A thin, delicate divider line or short decorative line may be added
- Overall clean, modern, with brand recognizability

2. Upper-Middle Title Zone
- Use a large bold title to display [Product Name]
- The title is centered above the main dish
- The font is heavy, eye-catching, modern, with a premium commercial advertisement feel
- Color suggestion is dark coffee, dark brown-black, or near-black
- A small number of small decorative lines, short dashes, or emphasis symbols consistent with the accent color may be added
- The title must be clear and impactful, serving as one of the first visual focal points of the image

3. Central Main Visual Zone
- The food corresponding to Image A is the core protagonist of the entire image
- The main dish is placed in the center of the image, large in size, high in visual proportion, and strongly dominant
- The food must present high-quality commercial food photography texture: realistic, tempting, clear, rich in detail, and highly appetizing
- Preserve the original food type and basic plating logic, only optimize lighting, details, layers, and refinement
- A small number of related garnishes may be added at the bottom or around the food, such as vegetables, herbs, fruit slices, sauce elements, etc., but must not overshadow the main subject
- Do not generate ugly, distorted, cheap, or overly AI-looking food effects

4. Left Ingredient Explanation Zone
- Set title: INGREDIENTS or Ingredient Highlights
- Vertically arrange 4–6 ingredient modules
- Each module contains: a real small ingredient image + ingredient name + a very short description
- Small ingredient images are recommended to be in a clean cutout-style commercial photography style, with slight shadows
- Use thin dashed arrows, curved arrows, or simple guide lines to establish a connection with the main dish
- Information should be short and clear, do not write in long paragraphs
- The left modules should overall be refined and orderly, not cluttered and stacked

5. Right Selling Point Explanation Zone
- Set title: NUTRITIONAL BENEFITS / PRODUCT BENEFITS / Product Selling Points
- Use simple, unified circular icons + selling point title + a short description
- Vertically arrange 4–5 selling point modules
- Icon style should be unified, modern, and simple, not complex and flashy
- Selling points can be expressed around directions such as: high protein, rich in vitamins, energy replenishment, rich mouthfeel, refreshing and non-greasy, satisfying and filling, light burden, authentic ingredients
- Expression should lean toward commercial marketing selling points, do not use exaggerated medical efficacy or treatment-oriented expressions
- The right modules should be clear and readable, but cannot overpower the visual weight of the central main dish

6. Bottom Price and Conversion Zone
- Set a PRICE or 价格 title centered at the bottom
- The price uses eye-catching large font, placed on a dark brush-stroke style background board
- The price needs to be very clear and prominent, with accurate currency unit
- Below, supplement the price unit, such as PER SERVING / Per Serving
- Further below, add a modern rounded-corner outlined button, with button text being [Button Text]
- The button should be clean, have a clickable feel, and possess a commercial conversion sense
- Overall, it should form a clear purchase guide, but should not look too much like a low-end promotional flyer

7. Bottommost Localized Social Guide Zone
- Do not use "Follow Us"
- Do not use overseas social platform logic such as Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, unless the user explicitly requests it
- Do not simultaneously display the dual presentation of "platform logo + platform text name"
- Do not repeatedly display platform names
- The bottom only retains a simple three-layer structure:
  1) One line of Chinese guide text
  2) One row of small-sized platform icons
  3) One line of Chinese search prompt

- The first line uses Chinese guide text, e.g.: [Bottom Guide Text]
- The second line only displays small-sized logo icons of 3–4 common Chinese platforms, no longer repeatedly writing platform text names
- Platform icons are selected from [Bottom Platform Icon Combination], e.g.:
  Douyin, Xiaohongshu, Video Account, Official Account, Meituan, Dianping
- Recommended priority combinations:
  A. Douyin + Xiaohongshu + Video Account + Official Account (more suitable for brand promotion and content dissemination)
  B. Douyin + Xiaohongshu + Meituan + Dianping (more suitable for local life and store conversion)
- Platform icons should be small-sized, unified in style, simply arranged, and can adopt monochrome dark, low-saturation style or simplified brand recognition style
- Icons only serve as a delicate bottom decoration, should not be too large, should not be eye-catching, and should not affect the overall premium feel
- The third line uses Chinese search guide, e.g.: [Bottom Search Guide]
- Do not use @accounts, do not make complex explanations, do not repeat platform names
- The overall effect should be simple, refined, localized, and credible, like the lightweight closing information at the bottom of a real Chinese restaurant brand poster

【Color Control】
The overall base color is mainly warm white / off-white / cream white, creating a clean, premium, warm, and appetizing tone.
The main text color is mainly dark brown, dark coffee, or near-black, forming a high-contrast reading experience.
The accent color uses [Accent Color], uniformly used for logo details, decorative lines, button elements, title small decorations, local emphasis, etc.
The natural colors of the food itself must become the core visual color source of the image, overall both unified and layered, cannot be gray-dirty or cheap.

【Texture Requirements】
The main food must possess the texture of premium food photography:
- sharp details
- rich colors
- realistic texture
- natural highlights
- believable shadows
- appetizing presentation
- polished commercial finish

The overall poster should look like a high-end promotional poster that a real restaurant brand would publish, rather than an ordinary AI collage image or a low-end menu page.

【Text and Information Density】
The image needs to have a certain amount of information, but must control clarity and readability.
All small text should be short, accurate, and clear, not too long.
The left ingredient explanation and right selling point explanation should both be concise and powerful, avoiding text stacking.
Title, price, button, and brand name must be clear and eye-catching.
Do not appear garbled text, typos, incorrect prices, incorrect brand names, disordered English, or unnatural copy.

【Restriction Requirements】
Do not replace the uploaded food.
Do not generate another dish.
Do not change the essential appearance and recognition features of the food.
Do not let the left and right information zones steal the visual dominance of the central main dish.
Do not excessively stack small text.
Do not use messy fonts.
Do not appear garbled text, typos, incorrect prices, or incorrect brand names.
Do not let icon styles be messy and inconsistent.
Do not make it into a low-end menu, cheap flyer, or overly templated poster.
Do not appear ugly AI-looking food.
Do not let the bottom social zone be too complex, do not repeatedly display platform information, do not let the bottom be more eye-catching than the price zone.

Ultimately output a portrait 2:3 high-end restaurant product promotional poster with strong commercial feel, high appetizing feel, high completion, balanced layout, clear brand recognition, suitable for Chinese local restaurant brand promotion use.

中文提示词:
请根据用户上传的食物图片，创作一张高完成度、适合社交媒体发布和餐饮品牌推广使用的「美食英雄说明书海报 / Food Hero Explainer Poster」。

【用户输入】
品牌名：【填写品牌名】
品牌副标题 / Slogan：【填写一句简短口号】
产品名：【填写产品名】
产品类别：【快餐 / 主食 / 饮品 / 甜品 / 地方菜 / 烘焙 / 轻食 / 其他】
左侧成分清单：【填写 4–6 个主要成分，每个成分附一句简短说明】
右侧卖点清单：【填写 4–5 个营养或产品卖点，每个卖点附一句简短说明】
价格：【填写价格】
价格单位：【每份 / 每杯 / 每盒 / PER SERVING / PER CUP / PER BOX】
按钮文案：【立即下单 / 立即购买 / 现在下单 / ORDER NOW / BUY NOW】
底部引导语：【如：更多新品｜优惠活动｜品牌动态 / 获取新品与优惠信息 / 更多福利请关注】
底部平台图标组合：【如：抖音 + 小红书 + 视频号 + 公众号；或 抖音 + 小红书 + 美团 + 大众点评】
底部搜索引导：【如：全平台搜索：品牌名 / 搜索品牌名：XXXX】
主色点缀：【例如橙色 / 红色 / 金黄色 / 绿色 / 草莓粉 / 黑金橙】
画幅比例：【竖版 2:3】

【核心参考规则】
Image A 是用户上传的主食物参考图，也是本次海报的核心主视觉依据。
必须严格保留这道食物的类型、主体外观、整体结构、核心摆盘方式、主要食材表现、色泽倾向和真实质感。
不要把这道菜替换成别的食物，不要重新生成另一种不同的菜品，不要改成另一种摆盘逻辑，不要让食物失真。
可以在保持主体一致的前提下，适度优化打光、清晰度、阴影层次、空间感和商业摄影质感，使其更像高级餐饮广告中的专业美食摄影，但不能改变产品本身。
重点是：保留原菜品识别度，只升级海报包装、版式设计与整体视觉呈现。

【整体定位】
这不是普通菜单图，也不是单纯美食摄影，而是一张融合「高端餐饮品牌广告 + 美食主视觉 + 成分说明 + 卖点信息栏 + 价格转化区」的商业促销海报。
整体气质应呈现 premium、clean、modern、polished、appetizing、realistic、professional food advertisement，适合新品推广、外卖平台展示、品牌宣传、社媒发布和餐厅单品广告。

【背景与整体风格】
使用柔和的暖米白、奶油白、浅暖 beige 作为背景，整体干净简洁，有轻微高级纸面质感或柔和棚拍空间感。
画面要留白舒服、排版均衡、视觉清爽，体现现代餐饮品牌感、轻奢菜单感和高完成度商业广告感。
不要使用复杂背景，不要装饰过度，不要廉价感，不要杂乱色彩干扰主体。

【版式结构】
采用稳定的竖版中心构图，信息分区清晰，主次分明，整体阅读路径自然：

1. 顶部品牌区
- 顶部居中放置简洁品牌 logo / 小图标
- 下方是品牌名
- 再下方是一句品牌副标题 / slogan
- 可加入一条细小精致的分隔线或短装饰线
- 整体简洁、现代、具有品牌识别度

2. 中上部标题区
- 使用大号粗体标题展示【产品名】
- 标题位于主菜上方居中位置
- 字体厚重、醒目、现代、有高级商业广告感
- 颜色建议为深咖啡色、深棕黑色或近黑色
- 可加入少量与主色点缀一致的小型装饰线、短划线或强调符号
- 标题必须清晰有冲击力，是画面的第一视觉焦点之一

3. 中央主视觉区
- Image A 对应的食物是整张图的核心主角
- 主菜放置在画面中央，尺寸大、视觉占比高、主导性强
- 食物必须呈现高质量商业美食摄影质感：真实、诱人、清晰、细节丰富、极具食欲
- 保留原有食物类型与基本摆盘逻辑，只优化灯光、细节、层次和精致感
- 可以在食物底部或周边加入少量相关辅料作点缀，例如蔬菜、香草、果片、酱汁元素等，但不可喧宾夺主
- 不要生成难看、失真、廉价、过度 AI 感的食物效果

4. 左侧成分说明区
- 设置标题：INGREDIENTS 或 成分亮点
- 垂直排列 4–6 个成分模块
- 每个模块包含：真实小食材图 + 成分名称 + 一句极简短说明
- 小食材图建议为干净抠图式商业摄影风格，带轻微阴影
- 使用细虚线箭头、弧形箭头或简洁引导线与主菜建立关联
- 信息简短清楚，不要写成大段说明
- 左侧模块整体要精致、有秩序，不能杂乱堆叠

5. 右侧卖点说明区
- 设置标题：NUTRITIONAL BENEFITS / PRODUCT BENEFITS / 产品卖点
- 使用简洁统一的圆形图标 + 卖点标题 + 一句短说明
- 垂直排列 4–5 个卖点模块
- 图标风格要统一、现代、简洁，不要复杂花哨
- 卖点可以围绕：高蛋白、富含维生素、补充能量、口感丰富、清爽解腻、饱腹满足、轻负担、真材实料等方向表达
- 表达偏商业营销卖点，不要使用夸张医疗功效或治疗化表述
- 右侧模块应清晰易读，但不能压过中央主菜的视觉权重

6. 底部价格与转化区
- 底部居中设置 PRICE 或 价格 标题
- 价格使用醒目的大号字体，放在深色 brush-stroke / 粗刷痕风格底板上
- 价格需要非常清晰突出，货币单位准确
- 下方补充价格单位，例如 PER SERVING / 每份
- 再下方加入现代圆角描边按钮，按钮文案为【按钮文案】
- 按钮应简洁、有点击感、具有商业转化感
- 整体要形成明确的购买引导，但不要太像低端促销传单

7. 最底部中国化社交引导区
- 不要使用 “Follow Us”
- 不要使用 Instagram、Facebook、TikTok 这类海外社交平台逻辑，除非用户明确要求
- 不要同时出现“平台 logo + 平台文字名称”的双重展示
- 不要重复显示平台名字
- 底部只保留简洁的三层结构：
  1）一行中文引导语
  2）一排小尺寸平台图标
  3）一行中文搜索提示

- 第一行使用中文引导语，例如：【底部引导语】
- 第二行仅展示 3–4 个中国常见平台的小尺寸 logo 图标，不再重复写平台文字名称
- 平台图标从【底部平台图标组合】中选择，例如：
  抖音、小红书、视频号、公众号、美团、大众点评
- 推荐优先组合：
  A. 抖音 + 小红书 + 视频号 + 公众号（更适合品牌宣传与内容传播）
  B. 抖音 + 小红书 + 美团 + 大众点评（更适合本地生活与门店转化）
- 平台图标应小尺寸、统一风格、简洁排布，可采用单色深色、低饱和风格或简化品牌识别风格
- 图标只作为底部精致点缀，不要过大，不要抢眼，不要影响整体高级感
- 第三行使用中文搜索引导，例如：【底部搜索引导】
- 不使用 @账号，不做复杂说明，不重复平台名字
- 整体效果应简洁、精致、本地化、可信，像真实中国餐饮品牌海报底部的轻量收尾信息

【色彩控制】
整体底色以暖白 / 米白 / 奶油白为主，营造干净高级、温暖有食欲的基调。
主文字颜色以深棕、深咖啡、近黑为主，形成高对比阅读感。
点缀色使用【主色点缀】，统一用于 logo 细节、装饰线、按钮元素、标题小装饰、局部强调等。
食物本身的天然颜色必须成为画面的核心视觉色彩来源，整体既统一又有层次感，不能灰脏或廉价。

【质感要求】
主食物必须具备 premium food photography 的质感：
- sharp details
- rich colors
- realistic texture
- natural highlights
- believable shadows
- appetizing presentation
- polished commercial finish

整体海报要像真实餐饮品牌会发布的高端促销海报，而不是普通 AI 拼贴图或低端菜单页。

【文字与信息密度】
画面需要有一定信息量，但必须控制清晰度与可读性。
所有小字都应短、准、清楚，不要过长。
左侧成分说明和右侧卖点说明都应简洁有力，避免堆字。
标题、价格、按钮、品牌名必须清晰醒目。
不要出现乱码、错字、错误价格、错误品牌名、错乱英文或不自然文案。

【限制要求】
不要替换上传的食物。
不要生成另一种菜。
不要改变食物的本质外观和识别特征。
不要让左右信息区抢走中央主菜的视觉主导地位。
不要过度堆砌小字。
不要使用混乱字体。
不要出现乱码、错字、错误价格或错误品牌名。
不要让图标风格杂乱不统一。
不要做成低端菜单、廉价传单或过度模板化的海报。
不要出现 ugly AI-looking food。
不要让底部社交区域过于复杂，不要重复展示平台信息，不要让底部比价格区更抢眼。

最终输出一张具有强商业感、高食欲感、高完成度、版式平衡、品牌识别清晰、适合中国本地餐饮品牌宣传使用的竖版 2:3 高级餐饮产品促销海报。

cases.prompt:
英文提示词:
You are a professional traditional Chinese Four Pillars of Destiny (Bazi) numerology naming master, well-versed in classics such as "Qiong Tong Bao Jian", "San Ming Tong Hui", "Di Tian Sui", "Yuan Hai Zi Ping", "Qian Li Ming Gao", "Xie Ji Bian Fang Shu", "Zi Ping Zhen Quan", "Shen Feng Tong Kao". Please combine Four Pillars charting, Ten Gods generation and restriction, Pattern likes and dislikes, Five Elements prosperity and decline, Major Luck and Annual Luck to complete numerology naming for personal names / company names, and generate high-quality naming comparison posters.

Overall Goal:
Output a readable, selectable, and collectible naming plan. The poster should simultaneously possess ancient poetic flavor, cultural art atmosphere, and modern design sense, not an ordinary infographic.

I. Naming Information
A. Personal Name Naming
- Surname: [Example: Li / Wang / Ouyang]
- Gender: [Male / Female]
- Birth Time (Gregorian): [Example: April 29, 2026, 14:30]
- Birthplace: [Example: Hangzhou, Zhejiang] (Used for true solar time correction, optional)
- Parents' Expectations: [Optional]
- Taboo Characters: [Optional]
B. Company Name Naming
- Industry Field: [Example: Technology / Culture / Catering / Investment / Education]
- Founder's Name + Birth Time: [Used to calculate the legal person's Bazi, extract favorable elements]
- Company Positioning / Business Direction
- Target Temperament
- Brand Name Length Preference: [2 characters / 3 characters / 4 characters / Unlimited]
- Taboo Characters: [Optional]
Poster Output Parameters
- Visual Style: [Apple tech sense / Historical sense / Ethereal sense / Vitality and vigor / Bold and unconstrained / Festive style / Sense of life / Leave blank random]
- Language Style: [Scholarly type / Literary type / Concise type / Plain-spoken type / Leave blank random]
- Poster Ratio: [Vertical 9:16 / Horizontal 4:3 / Horizontal 16:9 / Square 1:1 (Horizontal recommended)]
- Number of Names: [≥ 3, default 3]
III. Numerology Deduction Requirements
First complete the numerology deduction, then enter naming:
Charting → Day Master Strength → Pattern Determination → Five Elements Prosperity and Decline & Favorable Elements → Ten Gods Analysis → Major Luck and Annual Luck Brief → Character Selection Direction → Candidate Combinations.
Company names additionally consider:

Industry Five Elements attributes + Founder's favorable elements + Brand phonology + Spread memory.

If information is insufficient, such as the company founder lacking birth time, it must be stated:
"Because the birth time is not provided, the following is referenced by three pillars, without complete hour pillar precise charting."

Do not pretend to chart precisely.
IV. Text Content Requirements

Each naming object needs to include:
1. Numerology Overview, controlled within 200 words:
Four Pillars Bazi | Day Master Strength | Pattern | Favorable Elements / Taboo Elements | One-sentence temperament comment.

2. 3 Candidate Names.

Each candidate name is briefly analyzed from 5 dimensions, 1–2 sentences per item:

- Five Elements Supplementation: What Five Elements to supplement, what problems to reconcile.
- Character Meaning Connotation: Explain the original meaning, extended meaning, and cultural origin character by character.

- Three Talents and Five Grids: Heaven Grid, Personality Grid, Earth Grid, Outer Grid, Total Grid, explaining good/bad fortune and core imagery.
- Phonology and Character Form: Tones, rhymes, writing structure, aesthetics.
- Hexagram Implication: Hexagram image, Hexagram name, brief analysis of hexagram meaning.
3. Top Recommended Name + One-sentence reason.
The three candidate names must have different temperaments: Steady / Agile / Elegant, and must not be identical.
V. Poster Structure
Each poster is a single-image three-card comparison. It is strictly forbidden to appear partition texts such as "Area A / Area B / Area C".

The poster contains from top to bottom:
1. Main Title

Personal name poster title: "Ouyang · Naming Suggestions"

Company poster title: "AI Smart Hardware Brand · Naming Suggestions"

The title uses atmospheric handwriting, with the largest font size.

The title is decorated with a vermilion small seal or signature.
A one-line subtitle, pointing out "Numerology Naming / Plain-spoken type / Style keywords".
2. Destiny Owner Information Area
Displayed in two lines:
First line: User input information.
Second line: Numerology calculation information, including Four Pillars, Day Master strength, Pattern, Favorable Elements, Taboo Elements, one-sentence comment.

The two lines are distinguished by shades of background color, without using hard dividing lines.
3. Naming Deduction Chain
Horizontal flowchart:
Four Pillars → Day Master → Favorable Elements → Character Selection Direction → Three Candidate Names.
Nodes are equipped with small icons, connected by arrows, clearly showing "why it is named this way".

4. Candidate Name Cards
Three candidate names are side by side with equal width, as the visual main body.
Each card contains:
- Large character name: Handwriting centered, with the largest font size.

- Pinyin + Tones: Light gray small text.
- Top Recommended Badge: Only the top recommended card uses a "Top Recommended" seal or diagonal badge.
- Five Elements Supplementation: One sentence, ≤18 characters.
- Character Meaning Connotation: One sentence, ≤18 characters.
- Three Talents and Five Grids: One sentence, ≤18 characters.
- Phonology and Character Form: One sentence, ≤18 characters.
- Hexagram Implication: Hexagram image + Hexagram name + One sentence.
- Soul of the Name: ≤14 characters, extracting core temperament.
- Comprehensive Score + Temperament Tag.
5. Bottom Top Recommended Ending
Format:
"Top Recommended: Name —— One-sentence reason"
Presented centered, a vermilion seal can be added at the end: Lao Yang Naming.

VI. Layout Requirements
- Horizontal comparison tables are strictly prohibited; the three cards themselves are the comparison.
- Structural words such as "Area A / Area B / Area C" are strictly prohibited.
- Do not use obvious black borders or thick dividing lines.

- Rely on white space, font hierarchy, slight background color differences, seals, and patterns to organize information.

- There must be obvious breathing space between cards, and they must not be crowded.
- The top recommended card is centered, strengthened with seals, badges, light gold background color, or micro-gold tracing.
- Primary and secondary hierarchy: Large character name > Soul of the Name > Score > Five-dimension Analysis > Pinyin and Tones.
- Information must be clear, durable, and not wordy.
VII. Style Library
Visual Style Library:
1. Apple Tech Sense
Minimalist white space, cold-tone metal, geometric precision, low-saturation premium gray; can integrate abstract landscape, dot matrix texture, glass morphism, soft highlights.

2. Historical Sense

Stele rubbing bronze, aged paper, ancient book patterns, accumulation of years; can integrate residual scrolls, seals, annotations, colophons, bronze patterns.

3. Ethereal Sense
Ink wash blending, foggy mountain colors, white space elegance; can integrate distant mountains, clouds, withered lotus, lone boat, moonlight.

4. Vitality and Vigor
Saturated warm colors, growth elements, brisk rhythm; can integrate new branches and tender leaves, blooming flowers, flowing water, morning sun, flying birds.

5. Bold and Unconstrained

中文提示词:
你是一位专业中国传统四柱八字命理取名师，熟读《穷通宝鉴》《三命通会》《滴天髓》《渊海子平》《千里命稿》《协纪辨方书》《子平真诠》《神峰通考》等经典。请结合四柱排盘、十神生克、格局喜忌、五行旺衰、大运流年，为人名 / 公司名完成命理取名，并生成高质感取名对比海报。

整体目标：
输出一份可读、可选、可收藏的取名方案。海报要同时具备古风诗意、文化艺术氛围和现代设计感，不是普通信息图。

一、取名信息
A. 人名取名
- 姓氏：［示例：李 / 王 / 欧阳］
- 性别：［男 / 女］
- 出生时间（公历）：［示例：2026 年 4 月 29 日 14:30］
- 出生地：［示例：浙江杭州］（用于真太阳时校正，可选）
- 父母期许：［可选］
- 避讳字：［可选］
B. 公司取名
- 行业领域：［示例：科技 / 文化 / 餐饮 / 投资 / 教育］
- 创始人姓名 + 出生时间：［用于核算法人八字，提取喜用神］
- 公司定位 / 业务方向
- 目标气质
- 品牌名长度偏好：［2 字 / 3 字 / 4 字 / 不限］
- 避讳字：［可选］
海报输出参数
- 画面风格：［Apple 科技感 / 历史感 / 空灵感 / 生机活力 / 豪放 / 喜庆风 / 生命感 / 留空随机］
- 语言风格：［考究型 / 文学型 / 简洁型 / 说人话型 / 留空随机］
- 海报比例：［竖版 9:16 / 横版 4:3 / 横版 16:9 / 方版 1:1（推荐横版）］
- 取名数量：［≥ 3，默认 3 个］
三、命理推演要求
先完成命理推导，再进入取名：
排盘 → 日主强弱 → 格局判定 → 五行旺衰与喜用神 → 十神分析 → 大运流年简述 → 选字方向 → 候选组合。
公司名额外考虑：

行业五行属性 + 创始人喜用神 + 品牌音律 + 传播记忆度。

若信息不足，如公司创始人缺少出生时辰，必须说明：
“因未提供出生时辰，以下按三柱参考，不作完整时柱精排。”

不得假装精准排盘。
四、文字内容要求

每个取名对象需包含：
1. 命理速览，控制在200字以内：
四柱八字｜日主强弱｜格局｜喜用神 / 忌神｜一句话气质点评。

2. 候选名3个。

每个候选名从5个维度简析，每项1–2句：

- 五行补益：补什么五行，调和什么问题。
- 字义内涵：逐字解释本义、引申义、文化出处。

- 三才五格：天格、人格、地格、外格、总格，说明吉凶与核心象意。
- 音律字形：平仄、声韵、书写结构、美感。
- 卦象寓意：卦象图、卦名、卦义简析。
3. 首推名 + 一句话理由。
三个候选名气质要有差异：稳重 / 灵动 / 文雅，不能雷同。
五、海报结构
每张海报为单图三卡对比。严禁出现“A区 / B区 / C区”等分区文字。

海报自上而下包含：
1. 主标题

人名海报标题：「欧阳 · 取名建议」

公司海报标题：「AI智能硬件品牌 · 取名建议」

标题使用大气手写字，字号最大。

标题旁点缀朱红小印章或落款。
副标题一行，点明“命理取名 / 说人话型 / 风格关键词”。
2. 命主信息区
两行展示：
第一行：用户输入信息。
第二行：命理推算信息，包括四柱、日主强弱、格局、喜用神、忌神、一句话点评。

两行靠底色深浅区分，不使用硬分隔线。
3. 取名推导链
横向流程图：
四柱 → 日主 → 喜用神 → 选字方向 → 候选三名。
节点配小图标，箭头连接，清楚展示“为什么这么取”。

4. 候选名卡片
三个候选名等宽并列，作为视觉主体。
每张卡片包含：
- 名字大字：手写体居中，字号最大。

- 拼音 + 平仄：浅灰小字。
- 首推角标：仅首推卡片使用“首推”印章或斜角标。
- 五行补益：一句话，≤18字。
- 字义内涵：一句话，≤18字。
- 三才五格：一句话，≤18字。
- 音律字形：一句话，≤18字。
- 卦象寓意：卦象图 + 卦名 + 一句话。
- 名字之魂：≤14字，提炼核心气质。
- 综合评分 + 气质标签。
5. 底部首推收尾
格式：
「首推：名字——一句话理由」
居中呈现，末尾可加朱红印章：老杨取名。

六、排版要求
- 严禁横向对比表，三张卡片本身就是对比。
- 严禁出现“A区 / B区 / C区”等结构字样。
- 不用明显黑色边框或粗分割线。

- 依靠留白、字体层级、底色微差、印章和纹样组织信息。

- 卡片之间要有明显呼吸感，不能拥挤。
- 首推卡片居中，用印章、角标、浅金底色或微描金强化。
- 主次层级：名字大字 > 名字之魂 > 评分 > 五维解析 > 拼音平仄。
- 信息要清楚、耐看，不要堆字。
七、风格库
画面风格库：
1. Apple 科技感
极简留白、冷调金属、几何精度、低饱和高级灰；可融入抽象山水、点阵纹理、玻璃拟态、柔和高光。

2. 历史感

碑拓青铜、做旧纸张、古籍纹样、岁月沉淀；可融入残卷、印章、批注、题跋、青铜纹。

3. 空灵感
水墨晕染、雾气山色、留白飘逸；可融入远山、云气、枯荷、孤舟、月色。

4. 生机活力
饱和暖色、生长元素、明快节奏；可融入新枝嫩叶、繁花、流水、朝阳、飞鸟。

5. 豪放
大笔触浓墨、山河气势、构图开阔；可融入泼墨山水、苍松、巨石、云海。

6. 喜庆风
朱红描金、传统纹样、热烈饱满；可融入祥云、灯笼、缠枝纹、锦纹、红印章、金色边饰。

7. 生命感
有机曲线、温润色调、呼吸节奏；可融入草木、暖光、细叶、果实、流水、自然肌理。

语言风格库：
1. 考究型

用词精准，引经据典，注重出处和命理依据。
2. 文学型

意象丰富，修辞讲究，有诗意和韵律感。

3. 简洁型
短句为主，一字千金，重点清晰。

4. 说人话型
口语化、亲切易懂、零门槛阅读，但保留文化韵味。

八、本次默认风格调用
本次海报默认调用：

画面风格：喜庆风 + 生命感
语言风格：说人话型

视觉关键词：

宣纸肌理、米白底色、朱红点睛、金色描边、青绿草木、暖光晕染、山水云气、荷叶花枝、祥云纹样、朱红印章。
整体效果：
第一眼有诗意和收藏感，细看能读懂命理逻辑，30秒内能完成对比与决策。
